units.title: Academic humanities
units.intro: Grammar focus: Lectures and essays on history and philosophy; summarizing an argument

ex.zh: 如果你离开日本，我会非常想你的。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ lí kāi rì běn wǒ huì fēi cháng xiǎng nǐ de
ex.en: I will badly miss you if you leave Japan.

ex.zh: 令我非常伤心的是她考砸了。
ex.p: líng wǒ fēi cháng shāng xīn de shì tā kǎo zá le
ex.en: She failed the examination and I was greatly disappointed.

ex.zh: 在那儿看报纸的男人是我叔叔。
ex.p: zài nàr kàn bào zhǐ de nán rén shì wǒ shū shu
ex.en: The man reading a paper over there is my uncle.

ex.zh: 我在报纸上刊登了我的房子的广告。
ex.p: wǒ zài bào zhǐ shǎng kān dēng le wǒ de fáng zi de guǎng gào
ex.en: I advertised my house in the newspaper.

ex.zh: 我应该往你的咖啡里放多少糖呢？
ex.p: wǒ yīng gāi wǎng nǐ de kā fēi lǐ fàng duō shǎo táng ne
ex.en: How much sugar should I put in your coffee?

ex.zh: 你应该考虑的第一件事是时间。
ex.p: nǐ yīng gāi kǎo lǜ de dì yī jiàn shì shì shí jiān
ex.en: The first thing you have to take into consideration is time.

items.en: to commit a crime; crime; offense

ex.zh: 这个犯罪和我一点关系都没有。
ex.p: zhè gè fàn zuì hé wǒ yī diǎn guān xi dōu méi yǒu
ex.en: I have nothing to do with the crime.

ex.zh: 一名警探到达了犯罪现场。
ex.p: yī míng jǐng tàn dào dá le fàn zuì xiàn chǎng
ex.en: A detective arrived upon the scene of the crime.

ex.zh: 那个赛跑运动员跃过了地面上的洞。
ex.p: nà gè sài pǎo yùn dòng yuán yuè guò le dì miàn shǎng de dòng
ex.en: The runner jumped over the hole in the ground.

ex.zh: 如果那天下雨，比赛会顺延至下一个晴天。
ex.p: rú guǒ nà tiān xià yǔ bǐ sài huì shùn yán zhì xià yī gè qíng tiān
ex.en: If it rains on that day, the game will be postponed until the next fine day.

ex.zh: 我的一个女性朋友喜欢跟我一起去同志酒吧。
ex.p: wǒ de yī gè nǚ xìng péng you xǐ huan gēn wǒ yī qǐ qù tóng zhì jiǔ bā
ex.en: A female friend of mine loves to go to gay bars with me.

ex.zh: 假若他在这里，他会说什么？
ex.p: jià ruò tā zài zhè lǐ tā huì shuō shén me
ex.en: If he were here, what would he say?

ex.zh: 我真是欣喜若狂。
ex.p: wǒ zhēn shì xīn xǐ ruò kuáng
ex.en: I'm absolutely elated.

ex.zh: 所谓陌生人，只是还未相见的友人而已。
ex.p: suǒ wèi mò shēng rén zhǐ shì hái wèi xiāng jiàn de yǒu rén ér yǐ
ex.en: A stranger is just a friend you haven't met yet.

ex.zh: 只是一场梦而已。
ex.p: zhǐ shì yī cháng mèng ér yǐ
ex.en: It's just a dream.

ex.zh: 学中文的学生只有他们几个。
ex.p: xué zhōng wén de xué sheng zhǐ yǒu tā men jī gè
ex.en: They are the only students who study Chinese.

ex.zh: 我买了份英文写的报纸。
ex.p: wǒ mǎi le fèn yīng wén xiě de bào zhǐ
ex.en: I bought a newspaper written in English.

ex.zh: 您这个年龄的人经常有这个问题。
ex.p: nín zhè gè nián líng de rén jīng cháng yǒu zhè gè wèn tí
ex.en: People your age often have this problem.

ex.zh: 我今早起床时，我爸已经吃过早饭了。
ex.p: wǒ jīn zǎo qǐ chuáng shí wǒ bà yǐ jīng chī guò zǎo fàn le
ex.en: My father had already finished breakfast when I got up this morning.

ex.zh: 当爸爸发现你做了什么的时候，他会发疯的。
ex.p: dāng bà ba fā xiàn nǐ zuò le shén me de shí hou tā huì fā fēng de
ex.en: When Dad finds out what you've done, he's going to hit the roof.

ex.zh: 最后一个听我说我的主意的人认为我疯了。
ex.p: zuì hòu yī gè yǐn wǒ shuō wǒ de zhǔ yi de rén rèn wéi wǒ fēng le
ex.en: The last person I told my idea to thought I was nuts.

items.en: disembodied spirit; ghost; devil; sly; crafty; resourceful (variant of 诡)

ex.zh: 据说这房子是个鬼屋。
ex.p: jù shuō zhè fáng zi shì gè guǐ wū
ex.en: It is said the house is haunted.

ex.zh: 我不相信鬼魂存在。
ex.p: wǒ bù xiāng xìn guǐ hún cún zài
ex.en: I don't believe that ghosts exist.

ex.zh: 即使太阳从西边出来，我也不会改变主意。
ex.p: jí shǐ tài yang cóng xī biān chū lái wǒ yě bù huì gǎi biàn zhǔ yi
ex.en: Even if the sun were to rise in the west, I would not change my mind.

ex.zh: 即使我在学校学习了三年，我仍然不擅长说法语。
ex.p: jí shǐ wǒ zài xué xiào xué xí le sān nián wǒ réng rán bù shàn cháng shuō fǎ yǔ
ex.en: Even though I studied French for three years in school, I'm not good at speaking it.

ex.zh: 人是唯一会使用火的动物。
ex.p: rén shì wéi yī huì shǐ yòng huǒ de dòng wù
ex.en: Man is the only animal that can make use of fire.

ex.zh: 我是唯一能做到那个的人。
ex.p: wǒ shì wéi yī néng zuò dào nà gè de rén
ex.en: I'm the only one who can do that.

ex.zh: 他消失了，不留一丝踪迹。
ex.p: tā xiāo shī le bù liú yī sī zōng jì
ex.en: He disappeared without a trace.

ex.zh: 情况丝毫没有改变。
ex.p: qíng kuàng sī háo méi yǒu gǎi biàn
ex.en: The situation hasn't changed at all.

ex.zh: 她就是所谓的书虫。
ex.p: tā jiù shì suǒ wèi de shū chóng
ex.en: She is what we call a bookworm.

ex.zh: 所谓陌生人，只是还未相见的友人而已。
ex.p: suǒ wèi mò shēng rén zhǐ shì hái wèi xiāng jiàn de yǒu rén ér yǐ
ex.en: A stranger is just a friend you haven't met yet.

ex.zh: 警察会调查这起案件。
ex.p: jǐng chá huì diào chá zhè qǐ àn jiàn
ex.en: The police will look into the case.

ex.zh: 我从没读过那么恐怖的小说。
ex.p: wǒ cóng méi dòu guò nà me kǒng bù de xiǎo shuō
ex.en: I've never read such a scary novel.

ex.zh: 我痛恨恐怖主义组织。
ex.p: wǒ tòng hèn kǒng bù zhǔ yì zǔ zhī
ex.en: I hate terrorist organizations.

ex.zh: 你应该去竞选城市委员会。
ex.p: nǐ yīng gāi qù jìng xuǎn chéng shì wěi yuán huì
ex.en: You should run for city council.

ex.zh: 委员会一个月召开两次。
ex.p: wěi yuán huì yī gè yuè zhào kāi liǎng cì
ex.en: The committee meets twice a month.

items.en: to dance; to wield; to brandish

ex.zh: 我最好的朋友舞跳得很好。
ex.p: wǒ zuì hǎo de péng you wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo
ex.en: My best friend dances really well.

ex.zh: 我的女朋友跳舞跳得很棒。
ex.p: wǒ de nǚ péng you tiào wǔ tiào de hěn bàng
ex.en: My girlfriend is a good dancer.

ex.zh: 昨天晚上六点钟我们来到了这里。
ex.p: zuó tiān wǎn shang liù diǎn zhōng wǒ men lái dào le zhè lǐ
ex.en: We arrived here at six yesterday evening.

ex.zh: 我能跟你私下谈一分钟吗？
ex.p: wǒ néng gēn nǐ sī xià tán yī fēn zhōng ma
ex.en: Can I talk to you privately for a minute?

items.en: thigh; part of a whole; portion of a sum

ex.zh: 房里闻起来有股烟味。
ex.p: fáng lǐ wén qǐ lai yǒu gǔ yān wèi
ex.en: The room smelled of tobacco.

ex.zh: 房里有股烟味。
ex.p: fáng lǐ yǒu gǔ yān wèi
ex.en: The room smelled of tobacco.

ex.zh: 你们这些家伙真不懂事。
ex.p: nǐ men zhè xiē jiā huo zhēn bù dǒng shì
ex.en: You guys are totally clueless.

ex.zh: 我想要大家伙帮我个忙。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng yào dà jiā huǒ bāng wǒ gè máng
ex.en: I want you guys to do me a favor.

items.en: Ren County 任县 in Hebei

ex.zh: 我对你不负责任的态度感到惊讶。
ex.p: wǒ duì nǐ bù fù zé rén de tài du gǎn dào jīng yà
ex.en: I am alarmed by your irresponsible attitude.

ex.zh: 我老板把艰巨的任务指派给了我。
ex.p: wǒ lǎo bǎn bǎ jiān jù de rèn wu zhǐ pài gěi le wǒ
ex.en: My boss assigned the hard job to me.

items.en: attack (esp. surprise attack); raid; to attack

ex.zh: 台风袭击了关东地区。
ex.p: tái fēng xí jī le guān dōng dì qū
ex.en: The typhoon struck the Kanto district.

ex.zh: 我们被暴风雨袭击了。
ex.p: wǒ men bèi bào fēng yǔ xí jī le
ex.en: We were caught in a storm.

ex.zh: 你认为动物有灵魂吗？
ex.p: nǐ rèn wéi dòng wù yǒu líng hún ma
ex.en: Do you think animals have souls?

ex.zh: 你相信有幽灵吗？
ex.p: nǐ xiāng xìn yǒu yōu líng ma
ex.en: Do you believe in ghosts?

items.en: to smash; to pound; to fail

ex.zh: 有人把我新车的挡风玻璃砸碎了。
ex.p: yǒu rén bǎ wǒ xīn chē de dǎng fēng bō li zá suì le
ex.en: Someone smashed the windshield of my new car.

ex.zh: 他砸坏的是这扇窗。
ex.p: tā zá huài de shì zhè shān chuāng
ex.en: This is the window he broke.

ex.zh: 我们还有许多别的事情要讨论。
ex.p: wǒ men hái yǒu xǔ duō bié de shì qing yào tǎo lùn
ex.en: We still have many other things to discuss.

ex.zh: 今天许多学校因为风暴停课。
ex.p: jīn tiān xǔ duō xué xiào yīn wèi fēng bào tíng kè
ex.en: Many schools are closed today because of the storm.

ex.zh: 我真是欣喜若狂。
ex.p: wǒ zhēn shì xīn xǐ ruò kuáng
ex.en: I'm absolutely elated.

ex.zh: 他的评论简洁且击中要害。
ex.p: tā de píng lùn jiǎn jié qiě jī zhōng yào hài
ex.en: His comment was concise and to the point.

ex.zh: 我不知道这个城市，而且我一点都不懂那里的语言。
ex.p: wǒ bù zhī dào zhè gè chéng shì ér qiě wǒ yī diǎn dōu bù dǒng nà li de yǔ yán
ex.en: I didn't know the city, and what's more, I couldn't speak a word of the language.

ex.zh: 汤姆非常性感。
ex.p: tāng mǔ fēi cháng xìng gǎn
ex.en: Tom is so hot.

ex.zh: 我想乘地铁去。
ex.p: wǒ xiǎng chéng dì tiě qù
ex.en: I want to get there by subway.

ex.zh: 我搭地铁上学。
ex.p: wǒ dā dì tiě shàng xué
ex.en: I go to school by subway.

items.en: to inject; to pour into; to concentrate

ex.zh: 只有为数不多的几个电视节目值得关注。
ex.p: zhǐ yǒu wèi shù bù duō de jī gè diàn shì jié mù zhí de guān zhù
ex.en: Only a few TV programs are worth watching.

ex.zh: 我注意到她戴着新眼镜。
ex.p: wǒ zhù yì dào tā dài zhe xīn yǎn jìng
ex.en: I noticed that she was wearing new glasses.

ex.zh: 你所说的一切都将成为呈堂证供。
ex.p: nǐ suǒ shuō de yī qiè dōu jiāng chéng wéi chéng táng zhèng gōng
ex.en: Anything you say can be used against you in court.

ex.zh: 这所学校为学生提供教科书。
ex.p: zhè suǒ xué xiào wèi xué sheng tí gōng jiào kē shū
ex.en: This school supplies students with textbooks.

items.en: to explore; to search out; to scout

ex.zh: 我们在探险的时候遇到了很多困难。
ex.p: wǒ men zài tàn xiǎn de shí hou yù dào le hěn duō kùn nan
ex.en: We encountered a lot of difficulties on the expedition.

ex.zh: 他们出发去南极探险。
ex.p: tā men chū fā qù nán jí tàn xiǎn
ex.en: They went on an expedition to the Antarctic.

ex.zh: 法庭对他的谋杀罪名作出了无罪判决。
ex.p: fǎ tíng duì tā de móu shā zuì míng zuò chū le wú zuì pàn jué
ex.en: The court acquitted him of the charge of murder.

ex.zh: 汤姆不在你的联盟里。
ex.p: tāng mǔ bù zài nǐ de lián méng lǐ
ex.en: Tom is out of your league.

items.en: to attack; to assault; to go on the offensive

ex.zh: 他们进攻了敌人。
ex.p: tā men jìn gōng le dí rén
ex.en: They attacked the enemy.

ex.zh: 所有的马都是动物，但并非所有的动物都是马。
ex.p: suǒ yǒu de mǎ dōu shì dòng wù dàn bìng fēi suǒ yǒu de dòng wù dōu shì mǎ
ex.en: All horses are animals, but not all animals are horses.

ex.zh: 战争并非不可避免。
ex.p: zhàn zhēng bìng fēi bù kě bì miǎn
ex.en: War is not inevitable.

items.en: to bear; to carry (on one's back); to turn one's back on

ex.zh: 他是营销部的负责人。
ex.p: tā shì yíng xiāo bù de fù zé rén
ex.en: He's the manager of the marketing department.

ex.zh: 你要对结果负责。
ex.p: nǐ yào duì jiē guǒ fù zé
ex.en: You are responsible for the result.

items.en: to watch attentively; to fix one's attention on; to stare at

ex.zh: 没人盯着她的时候，她甚至会哭。
ex.p: méi rén dīng zhe tā de shí hou tā shèn zhì huì kū
ex.en: She'll cry even when no one is looking.

ex.zh: 不要再这么盯着我了。
ex.p: bù yào zài zhè me dīng zhe wǒ le
ex.en: Stop staring at me like that.

ex.zh: 每个人都可能变成尸体。
ex.p: měi gè rén dōu kě néng biàn chéng shī tǐ
ex.en: Every man is a potential corpse.

ex.zh: 这就是发现尸体的房间。
ex.p: zhè jiù shì fā xiàn shī tǐ de fáng jiān
ex.en: This is the room where the body was found.

items.en: to set up; to put in place; (math.) given; suppose; if

ex.zh: 我们要设法跟他们交流。
ex.p: wǒ men yào shè fǎ gēn tā men jiāo liú
ex.en: We have to try to communicate with them.

ex.zh: 我改了一下我网站的版面设计。
ex.p: wǒ gǎi le yī xià wǒ wǎng zhàn de bǎn miàn shè jì
ex.en: I've changed my website's layout.

items.en: prop; support (for weight); rest (e.g. arm rest)

ex.zh: 我把我的财产托付给他。
ex.p: wǒ bǎ wǒ de cái chǎn tuō fù gěi tā
ex.en: I entrusted my property to him.

ex.zh: 拜托，别留我一个人。
ex.p: bài tuō bié liú wǒ yī gè rén
ex.en: Please don't leave me alone.

items.en: to push aside with the hand, foot, a stick etc; to dial; to allocate
bean vermicelli; mung bean starch noodles; Chinese vermicelli

ex.zh: 我是足球的忠实粉丝。
ex.p: wǒ shì zú qiú de zhōng shí fěn sī
ex.en: I'm a big football fan.

items.en: place; location; (after a noun) place where it is located

ex.zh: 我告诉了他问题所在。
ex.p: wǒ gào sù le tā wèn tí suǒ zài
ex.en: I told him what the problem was.

ex.zh: 男厕所在二楼。
ex.p: nán cè suǒ zài èr lóu
ex.en: The men's room is on the second floor.

ex.zh: 你认为动物有灵魂吗？
ex.p: nǐ rèn wéi dòng wù yǒu líng hún ma
ex.en: Do you think animals have souls?

ex.zh: 她认出那枚胸针是她几个月前丢失的。
ex.p: tā rèn chū nà méi xiōng zhēn shì tā jī gè yuè qián diū shī de
ex.en: She recognized the brooch as the one she had lost a few months before.

ex.zh: 他拿出了几枚硬币。
ex.p: tā ná chū le jī méi yìng bì
ex.en: He took out some coins.

ex.zh: 我没有一点退休的念头。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu yī diǎn tuì xiū de niàn tou
ex.en: I don't have the slightest intention of retiring.

items.en: emptiness; void; abstract theory or guiding principles

ex.zh: 没有笑声的一天肯定是最为虚度的一天。
ex.p: méi yǒu xiào shēng de yī tiān kěn dìng shì zuì wèi xū dù de yī tiān
ex.en: A day without laughter is a day wasted.

ex.zh: 她虚弱的样子让我捏了一把汗。
ex.p: tā xū ruò de yàng zi ràng wǒ niē le yī bǎ hán
ex.en: It worried me that she looked pale.

ex.zh: 这是场有趣的辩论。
ex.p: zhè shì cháng yǒu qù de biàn lùn
ex.en: It was an interesting debate.

items.en: to give thought (to others); to consider (other people's needs)

ex.zh: 汤姆急着想知道结果。
ex.p: tāng mǔ jí zhuó xiǎng zhī dào jiē guǒ
ex.en: Tom is anxious to know the result.

items.en: short, simple literary or artistic creation; essay; skit
to explain oneself; to express; to reveal one's thoughts or feelings
train of thought; emotional state; mood

ex.zh: 工作之前先收好思绪。
ex.p: gōng zuò zhī qián xiān shōu hǎo sī xù
ex.en: Collect your thoughts before you begin your work.

items.en: to stare blankly; to be stunned; to be lost in thought
to be pregnant; to produce offspring; fig. replete with (culture etc)
to prove a point; to expound on; to demonstrate or prove (through argument)
to educate; to bring up; to nurture; upbringing; breeding; culture

ex.zh: 他是个有教养的人。
ex.p: tā shì gè yǒu jiào yǎng de rén
ex.en: He is a learned man.

items.en: one's thoughts and feelings; emotional stirring; moved
concentrating one's thoughts and efforts; single-minded; bent on

ex.zh: 她一心一意地工作。
ex.p: tā yī xīn yī yì de gōng zuò
ex.en: She works with single-minded determination.

items.en: profound theory (in Daoism and Buddhism); mysterious principles
(idiom) to have a well thought out plan in mind
thought-provoking; worth thinking over; to provide food for thought

ex.zh: 我在考虑明年去美国学习。
ex.p: wǒ zài kǎo lǜ míng nián qù měi guó xué xí
ex.en: I'm considering studying in America next year.

ex.zh: 他去美国学医了。
ex.p: tā qù měi guó xué yī le
ex.en: He went to America to study medicine.

exercises.en: She failed the examination and I was greatly disappointed.

exercises.zh: 在那儿看报纸的男人是我叔叔。
exercises.p: zài nàr kàn bào zhǐ de nán rén shì wǒ shū shu
exercises.en: The man reading a paper over there is my uncle.

exercises.zh: 我应该往你的咖啡里放多少糖呢？
exercises.p: wǒ yīng gāi wǎng nǐ de kā fēi lǐ fàng duō shǎo táng ne
exercises.en: How much sugar should I put in your coffee?

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 7–9 · 第133单元

Academic humanities

Grammar focus: Lectures and essays on history and philosophy; summarizing an argument

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

lessons.title: 教养、感触、交集、史无前例…
文人、胸有成竹、耐人寻味、出神…

sents.zh: 如果你离开日本，我会非常想你的。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ lí kāi rì běn wǒ huì fēi cháng xiǎng nǐ de
sents.en: I will badly miss you if you leave Japan.

sents.zh: 令我非常伤心的是她考砸了。
sents.p: líng wǒ fēi cháng shāng xīn de shì tā kǎo zá le
sents.en: She failed the examination and I was greatly disappointed.

sents.zh: 在那儿看报纸的男人是我叔叔。
sents.p: zài nàr kàn bào zhǐ de nán rén shì wǒ shū shu
sents.en: The man reading a paper over there is my uncle.

sents.zh: 我在报纸上刊登了我的房子的广告。
sents.p: wǒ zài bào zhǐ shǎng kān dēng le wǒ de fáng zi de guǎng gào
sents.en: I advertised my house in the newspaper.

sents.zh: 我应该往你的咖啡里放多少糖呢？
sents.p: wǒ yīng gāi wǎng nǐ de kā fēi lǐ fàng duō shǎo táng ne
sents.en: How much sugar should I put in your coffee?

sents.zh: 你应该考虑的第一件事是时间。
sents.p: nǐ yīng gāi kǎo lǜ de dì yī jiàn shì shì shí jiān
sents.en: The first thing you have to take into consideration is time.

sents.zh: 这个犯罪和我一点关系都没有。
sents.p: zhè gè fàn zuì hé wǒ yī diǎn guān xi dōu méi yǒu
sents.en: I have nothing to do with the crime.

sents.zh: 一名警探到达了犯罪现场。
sents.p: yī míng jǐng tàn dào dá le fàn zuì xiàn chǎng
sents.en: A detective arrived upon the scene of the crime.

sents.zh: 那个赛跑运动员跃过了地面上的洞。
sents.p: nà gè sài pǎo yùn dòng yuán yuè guò le dì miàn shǎng de dòng
sents.en: The runner jumped over the hole in the ground.

sents.zh: 如果那天下雨，比赛会顺延至下一个晴天。
sents.p: rú guǒ nà tiān xià yǔ bǐ sài huì shùn yán zhì xià yī gè qíng tiān
sents.en: If it rains on that day, the game will be postponed until the next fine day.

sents.zh: 我的一个女性朋友喜欢跟我一起去同志酒吧。
sents.p: wǒ de yī gè nǚ xìng péng you xǐ huan gēn wǒ yī qǐ qù tóng zhì jiǔ bā
sents.en: A female friend of mine loves to go to gay bars with me.

sents.zh: 假若他在这里，他会说什么？
sents.p: jià ruò tā zài zhè lǐ tā huì shuō shén me
sents.en: If he were here, what would he say?

sents.zh: 我真是欣喜若狂。
sents.p: wǒ zhēn shì xīn xǐ ruò kuáng
sents.en: I'm absolutely elated.

sents.zh: 所谓陌生人，只是还未相见的友人而已。
sents.p: suǒ wèi mò shēng rén zhǐ shì hái wèi xiāng jiàn de yǒu rén ér yǐ
sents.en: A stranger is just a friend you haven't met yet.

sents.zh: 只是一场梦而已。
sents.p: zhǐ shì yī cháng mèng ér yǐ
sents.en: It's just a dream.

sents.zh: 学中文的学生只有他们几个。
sents.p: xué zhōng wén de xué sheng zhǐ yǒu tā men jī gè
sents.en: They are the only students who study Chinese.

sents.zh: 我买了份英文写的报纸。
sents.p: wǒ mǎi le fèn yīng wén xiě de bào zhǐ
sents.en: I bought a newspaper written in English.

sents.zh: 您这个年龄的人经常有这个问题。
sents.p: nín zhè gè nián líng de rén jīng cháng yǒu zhè gè wèn tí
sents.en: People your age often have this problem.

sents.zh: 我今早起床时，我爸已经吃过早饭了。
sents.p: wǒ jīn zǎo qǐ chuáng shí wǒ bà yǐ jīng chī guò zǎo fàn le
sents.en: My father had already finished breakfast when I got up this morning.

sents.zh: 当爸爸发现你做了什么的时候，他会发疯的。
sents.p: dāng bà ba fā xiàn nǐ zuò le shén me de shí hou tā huì fā fēng de
sents.en: When Dad finds out what you've done, he's going to hit the roof.

sents.zh: 最后一个听我说我的主意的人认为我疯了。
sents.p: zuì hòu yī gè yǐn wǒ shuō wǒ de zhǔ yi de rén rèn wéi wǒ fēng le
sents.en: The last person I told my idea to thought I was nuts.

sents.zh: 据说这房子是个鬼屋。
sents.p: jù shuō zhè fáng zi shì gè guǐ wū
sents.en: It is said the house is haunted.

sents.zh: 我不相信鬼魂存在。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiāng xìn guǐ hún cún zài
sents.en: I don't believe that ghosts exist.

sents.zh: 即使太阳从西边出来，我也不会改变主意。
sents.p: jí shǐ tài yang cóng xī biān chū lái wǒ yě bù huì gǎi biàn zhǔ yi
sents.en: Even if the sun were to rise in the west, I would not change my mind.

sents.zh: 即使我在学校学习了三年，我仍然不擅长说法语。
sents.p: jí shǐ wǒ zài xué xiào xué xí le sān nián wǒ réng rán bù shàn cháng shuō fǎ yǔ
sents.en: Even though I studied French for three years in school, I'm not good at speaking it.

sents.zh: 人是唯一会使用火的动物。
sents.p: rén shì wéi yī huì shǐ yòng huǒ de dòng wù
sents.en: Man is the only animal that can make use of fire.

sents.zh: 我是唯一能做到那个的人。
sents.p: wǒ shì wéi yī néng zuò dào nà gè de rén
sents.en: I'm the only one who can do that.

sents.zh: 他消失了，不留一丝踪迹。
sents.p: tā xiāo shī le bù liú yī sī zōng jì
sents.en: He disappeared without a trace.

sents.zh: 情况丝毫没有改变。
sents.p: qíng kuàng sī háo méi yǒu gǎi biàn
sents.en: The situation hasn't changed at all.

sents.zh: 她就是所谓的书虫。
sents.p: tā jiù shì suǒ wèi de shū chóng
sents.en: She is what we call a bookworm.

sents.zh: 警察会调查这起案件。
sents.p: jǐng chá huì diào chá zhè qǐ àn jiàn
sents.en: The police will look into the case.

sents.zh: 我从没读过那么恐怖的小说。
sents.p: wǒ cóng méi dòu guò nà me kǒng bù de xiǎo shuō
sents.en: I've never read such a scary novel.

sents.zh: 我痛恨恐怖主义组织。
sents.p: wǒ tòng hèn kǒng bù zhǔ yì zǔ zhī
sents.en: I hate terrorist organizations.

sents.zh: 你应该去竞选城市委员会。
sents.p: nǐ yīng gāi qù jìng xuǎn chéng shì wěi yuán huì
sents.en: You should run for city council.

sents.zh: 委员会一个月召开两次。
sents.p: wěi yuán huì yī gè yuè zhào kāi liǎng cì
sents.en: The committee meets twice a month.

sents.zh: 我最好的朋友舞跳得很好。
sents.p: wǒ zuì hǎo de péng you wǔ tiào de hěn hǎo
sents.en: My best friend dances really well.

sents.zh: 我的女朋友跳舞跳得很棒。
sents.p: wǒ de nǚ péng you tiào wǔ tiào de hěn bàng
sents.en: My girlfriend is a good dancer.

sents.zh: 昨天晚上六点钟我们来到了这里。
sents.p: zuó tiān wǎn shang liù diǎn zhōng wǒ men lái dào le zhè lǐ
sents.en: We arrived here at six yesterday evening.

sents.zh: 我能跟你私下谈一分钟吗？
sents.p: wǒ néng gēn nǐ sī xià tán yī fēn zhōng ma
sents.en: Can I talk to you privately for a minute?

sents.zh: 房里闻起来有股烟味。
sents.p: fáng lǐ wén qǐ lai yǒu gǔ yān wèi
sents.en: The room smelled of tobacco.

sents.zh: 房里有股烟味。
sents.p: fáng lǐ yǒu gǔ yān wèi
sents.en: The room smelled of tobacco.

sents.zh: 你们这些家伙真不懂事。
sents.p: nǐ men zhè xiē jiā huo zhēn bù dǒng shì
sents.en: You guys are totally clueless.

sents.zh: 我想要大家伙帮我个忙。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng yào dà jiā huǒ bāng wǒ gè máng
sents.en: I want you guys to do me a favor.

sents.zh: 我对你不负责任的态度感到惊讶。
sents.p: wǒ duì nǐ bù fù zé rén de tài du gǎn dào jīng yà
sents.en: I am alarmed by your irresponsible attitude.

sents.zh: 我老板把艰巨的任务指派给了我。
sents.p: wǒ lǎo bǎn bǎ jiān jù de rèn wu zhǐ pài gěi le wǒ
sents.en: My boss assigned the hard job to me.

sents.zh: 台风袭击了关东地区。
sents.p: tái fēng xí jī le guān dōng dì qū
sents.en: The typhoon struck the Kanto district.

sents.zh: 我们被暴风雨袭击了。
sents.p: wǒ men bèi bào fēng yǔ xí jī le
sents.en: We were caught in a storm.

sents.zh: 你认为动物有灵魂吗？
sents.p: nǐ rèn wéi dòng wù yǒu líng hún ma
sents.en: Do you think animals have souls?

sents.zh: 你相信有幽灵吗？
sents.p: nǐ xiāng xìn yǒu yōu líng ma
sents.en: Do you believe in ghosts?

sents.zh: 有人把我新车的挡风玻璃砸碎了。
sents.p: yǒu rén bǎ wǒ xīn chē de dǎng fēng bō li zá suì le
sents.en: Someone smashed the windshield of my new car.

sents.zh: 他砸坏的是这扇窗。
sents.p: tā zá huài de shì zhè shān chuāng
sents.en: This is the window he broke.

sents.zh: 我们还有许多别的事情要讨论。
sents.p: wǒ men hái yǒu xǔ duō bié de shì qing yào tǎo lùn
sents.en: We still have many other things to discuss.

sents.zh: 今天许多学校因为风暴停课。
sents.p: jīn tiān xǔ duō xué xiào yīn wèi fēng bào tíng kè
sents.en: Many schools are closed today because of the storm.

sents.zh: 他的评论简洁且击中要害。
sents.p: tā de píng lùn jiǎn jié qiě jī zhōng yào hài
sents.en: His comment was concise and to the point.

sents.zh: 我不知道这个城市，而且我一点都不懂那里的语言。
sents.p: wǒ bù zhī dào zhè gè chéng shì ér qiě wǒ yī diǎn dōu bù dǒng nà li de yǔ yán
sents.en: I didn't know the city, and what's more, I couldn't speak a word of the language.

sents.zh: 汤姆非常性感。
sents.p: tāng mǔ fēi cháng xìng gǎn
sents.en: Tom is so hot.

sents.zh: 我想乘地铁去。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng chéng dì tiě qù
sents.en: I want to get there by subway.

sents.zh: 我搭地铁上学。
sents.p: wǒ dā dì tiě shàng xué
sents.en: I go to school by subway.

sents.zh: 只有为数不多的几个电视节目值得关注。
sents.p: zhǐ yǒu wèi shù bù duō de jī gè diàn shì jié mù zhí de guān zhù
sents.en: Only a few TV programs are worth watching.

sents.zh: 我注意到她戴着新眼镜。
sents.p: wǒ zhù yì dào tā dài zhe xīn yǎn jìng
sents.en: I noticed that she was wearing new glasses.

sents.zh: 你所说的一切都将成为呈堂证供。
sents.p: nǐ suǒ shuō de yī qiè dōu jiāng chéng wéi chéng táng zhèng gōng
sents.en: Anything you say can be used against you in court.

sents.zh: 这所学校为学生提供教科书。
sents.p: zhè suǒ xué xiào wèi xué sheng tí gōng jiào kē shū
sents.en: This school supplies students with textbooks.

sents.zh: 我们在探险的时候遇到了很多困难。
sents.p: wǒ men zài tàn xiǎn de shí hou yù dào le hěn duō kùn nan
sents.en: We encountered a lot of difficulties on the expedition.

sents.zh: 他们出发去南极探险。
sents.p: tā men chū fā qù nán jí tàn xiǎn
sents.en: They went on an expedition to the Antarctic.

sents.zh: 法庭对他的谋杀罪名作出了无罪判决。
sents.p: fǎ tíng duì tā de móu shā zuì míng zuò chū le wú zuì pàn jué
sents.en: The court acquitted him of the charge of murder.

sents.zh: 汤姆不在你的联盟里。
sents.p: tāng mǔ bù zài nǐ de lián méng lǐ
sents.en: Tom is out of your league.

sents.zh: 他们进攻了敌人。
sents.p: tā men jìn gōng le dí rén
sents.en: They attacked the enemy.

sents.zh: 所有的马都是动物，但并非所有的动物都是马。
sents.p: suǒ yǒu de mǎ dōu shì dòng wù dàn bìng fēi suǒ yǒu de dòng wù dōu shì mǎ
sents.en: All horses are animals, but not all animals are horses.

sents.zh: 战争并非不可避免。
sents.p: zhàn zhēng bìng fēi bù kě bì miǎn
sents.en: War is not inevitable.

sents.zh: 他是营销部的负责人。
sents.p: tā shì yíng xiāo bù de fù zé rén
sents.en: He's the manager of the marketing department.

sents.zh: 你要对结果负责。
sents.p: nǐ yào duì jiē guǒ fù zé
sents.en: You are responsible for the result.

sents.zh: 没人盯着她的时候，她甚至会哭。
sents.p: méi rén dīng zhe tā de shí hou tā shèn zhì huì kū
sents.en: She'll cry even when no one is looking.

sents.zh: 不要再这么盯着我了。
sents.p: bù yào zài zhè me dīng zhe wǒ le
sents.en: Stop staring at me like that.

sents.zh: 每个人都可能变成尸体。
sents.p: měi gè rén dōu kě néng biàn chéng shī tǐ
sents.en: Every man is a potential corpse.

sents.zh: 这就是发现尸体的房间。
sents.p: zhè jiù shì fā xiàn shī tǐ de fáng jiān
sents.en: This is the room where the body was found.

sents.zh: 我们要设法跟他们交流。
sents.p: wǒ men yào shè fǎ gēn tā men jiāo liú
sents.en: We have to try to communicate with them.

sents.zh: 我改了一下我网站的版面设计。
sents.p: wǒ gǎi le yī xià wǒ wǎng zhàn de bǎn miàn shè jì
sents.en: I've changed my website's layout.

sents.zh: 我把我的财产托付给他。
sents.p: wǒ bǎ wǒ de cái chǎn tuō fù gěi tā
sents.en: I entrusted my property to him.

sents.zh: 拜托，别留我一个人。
sents.p: bài tuō bié liú wǒ yī gè rén
sents.en: Please don't leave me alone.

sents.zh: 我是足球的忠实粉丝。
sents.p: wǒ shì zú qiú de zhōng shí fěn sī
sents.en: I'm a big football fan.

sents.zh: 我告诉了他问题所在。
sents.p: wǒ gào sù le tā wèn tí suǒ zài
sents.en: I told him what the problem was.

sents.zh: 男厕所在二楼。
sents.p: nán cè suǒ zài èr lóu
sents.en: The men's room is on the second floor.

sents.zh: 她认出那枚胸针是她几个月前丢失的。
sents.p: tā rèn chū nà méi xiōng zhēn shì tā jī gè yuè qián diū shī de
sents.en: She recognized the brooch as the one she had lost a few months before.

sents.zh: 他拿出了几枚硬币。
sents.p: tā ná chū le jī méi yìng bì
sents.en: He took out some coins.

sents.zh: 我没有一点退休的念头。
sents.p: wǒ méi yǒu yī diǎn tuì xiū de niàn tou
sents.en: I don't have the slightest intention of retiring.

sents.zh: 没有笑声的一天肯定是最为虚度的一天。
sents.p: méi yǒu xiào shēng de yī tiān kěn dìng shì zuì wèi xū dù de yī tiān
sents.en: A day without laughter is a day wasted.

sents.zh: 她虚弱的样子让我捏了一把汗。
sents.p: tā xū ruò de yàng zi ràng wǒ niē le yī bǎ hán
sents.en: It worried me that she looked pale.

sents.zh: 这是场有趣的辩论。
sents.p: zhè shì cháng yǒu qù de biàn lùn
sents.en: It was an interesting debate.

sents.zh: 汤姆急着想知道结果。
sents.p: tāng mǔ jí zhuó xiǎng zhī dào jiē guǒ
sents.en: Tom is anxious to know the result.

sents.zh: 工作之前先收好思绪。
sents.p: gōng zuò zhī qián xiān shōu hǎo sī xù
sents.en: Collect your thoughts before you begin your work.

sents.zh: 他是个有教养的人。
sents.p: tā shì gè yǒu jiào yǎng de rén
sents.en: He is a learned man.

sents.zh: 她一心一意地工作。
sents.p: tā yī xīn yī yì de gōng zuò
sents.en: She works with single-minded determination.

sents.zh: 我在考虑明年去美国学习。
sents.p: wǒ zài kǎo lǜ míng nián qù měi guó xué xí
sents.en: I'm considering studying in America next year.

sents.zh: 他去美国学医了。
sents.p: tā qù měi guó xué yī le
sents.en: He went to America to study medicine.

units.title: Academic humanities
units.intro: Grammar focus: Lectures and essays on history and philosophy; summarizing an argument

items.en: to cut short; extinct; to disappear

ex.zh: 她拒绝了每一项提议。
ex.p: tā jù jué le měi yī xiàng tí yì
ex.en: She turned down every proposal.

ex.zh: 我拒绝回答你的问题。
ex.p: wǒ jù jué huí dá nǐ de wèn tí
ex.en: I refuse to answer your question.

items.en: to rein in; to compel; to force

ex.zh: 中小企业要勒紧裤带才能存活。

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 7–9 · 第134单元

Academic humanities

Grammar focus: Lectures and essays on history and philosophy; summarizing an argument

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 她拒绝了每一项提议。
sents.p: tā jù jué le měi yī xiàng tí yì
sents.en: She turned down every proposal.

sents.zh: 我拒绝回答你的问题。
sents.p: wǒ jù jué huí dá nǐ de wèn tí
sents.en: I refuse to answer your question.

sents.zh: 中小企业要勒紧裤带才能存活。
sents.p: zhōng xiǎo qǐ yè yào lè jǐn kù dài cái néng cún huó
sents.en: Small businesses will have to tighten their belts to survive.

sents.zh: 我是素食主义者。
sents.p: wǒ shì sù shí zhǔ yì zhě
sents.en: I'm vegetarian.

sents.zh: 他认为只有训练有素的演员才能够获得成功。
sents.p: tā rèn wéi zhǐ yǒu xùn liàn yǒu sù de yǎn yuán cái néng gòu huò dé chéng gōng
sents.en: He thinks that only very well trained actors can be really successful.

sents.zh: 我想我会一辈子单身。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng wǒ huì yī bèi zi dān shēn
sents.en: I guess I'm never going to get married.

sents.zh: 汤姆一直都是单身汉。
sents.p: tāng mǔ yī zhí dōu shì dān shēn hàn
sents.en: Tom has always been a bachelor.

sents.zh: 我不相信他是真心的。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiāng xìn tā shì zhēn xīn de
sents.en: I don't think he is sincere.

sents.zh: 你应该用一下除臭剂。
sents.p: nǐ yīng gāi yòng yī xià chú chòu jì
sents.en: You should use a deodorant.

sents.zh: 一等奖是公主的香吻。
sents.p: yī děng jiǎng shì gōng zhǔ de xiāng wěn
sents.en: The grand prize is a kiss from the princess.

sents.zh: 亲吻一个抽烟的人就像在舔烟灰缸。
sents.p: qīn wěn yī gè chōu yān de rén jiù xiàng zài tiǎn yān huī gāng
sents.en: Kissing a smoker is like licking an ashtray.

sents.zh: 我痛恨恐怖主义组织。
sents.p: wǒ tòng hèn kǒng bù zhǔ yì zǔ zhī
sents.en: I hate terrorist organizations.

sents.zh: 你是个乐观主义者。
sents.p: nǐ shì gè lè guān zhǔ yì zhě
sents.en: You're an optimist.

sents.zh: 他问我，是不是知道她的电话号码。
sents.p: tā wèn wǒ shì bù shì zhī dào tā de diàn huà hào mǎ
sents.en: He asked me if I knew her telephone number.

sents.zh: 东京巨蛋的电话号码是多少？
sents.p: dōng jīng jù dàn de diàn huà hào mǎ shì duō shǎo
sents.en: What's the number for the Tokyo Dome?

sents.zh: 你知道中央情报局的什么？
sents.p: nǐ zhī dào zhōng yāng qíng bào jú de shén me
sents.en: What do you know about the CIA?

sents.zh: 别告诉任何人我尿床了。
sents.p: bié gào sù rèn hé rén wǒ niào chuáng le
sents.en: Don't tell anyone that I wet the bed.

sents.zh: 汤姆是糖尿病患者。
sents.p: tāng mǔ shì táng niào bìng huàn zhě
sents.en: Tom's diabetic.

sents.zh: 我需要你的护照和三张照片。
sents.p: wǒ xū yào nǐ de hù zhào hé sān zhāng zhào piàn
sents.en: I need your passport and three photographs.

sents.zh: 请把您的护照给我看一下。
sents.p: qǐng bǎ nín de hù zhào gěi wǒ kàn yī xià
sents.en: Show me your passport, please.

sents.zh: 你计划去大学后主修什么吗？
sents.p: nǐ jì huà qù dà xué hòu zhǔ xiū shén me ma
sents.en: What do you plan to major in at college?

sents.zh: 做计划是一码事，付诸实践是另一码事。
sents.p: zuò jì huà shì yī mǎ shì fù zhū shí jiàn shì lìng yī mǎ shì
sents.en: It's one thing to make plans, but quite another to carry them out.

sents.zh: 由于噪音，我无法集中精力工作了。
sents.p: yóu yú zào yīn wǒ wú fǎ jí zhōng jīng lì gōng zuò le
sents.en: I can't concentrate on my work because of the noise.

sents.zh: 演讲者精彩的演说给我们留下了深刻的印象。
sents.p: yǎn jiǎng zhě jīng cǎi de yǎn shuō gěi wǒ men liú xià le shēn kè de yìn xiàng
sents.en: We were deeply impressed by the lecturer's eloquent speech.

sents.zh: 小镇被暴风雨后的洪水摧毁了。
sents.p: xiǎo zhèn bèi bào fēng yǔ hòu de hóng shuǐ cuī huǐ le
sents.en: The town was destroyed by the flood after the storm.

sents.zh: 根据电视新闻，一架飞机在印度坠毁了。
sents.p: gēn jù diàn shì xīn wén yī jià fēi jī zài yìn dù zhuì huǐ le
sents.en: According to TV news, there was a plane crash in India.

sents.zh: 我会战斗至死。
sents.p: wǒ huì zhàn dòu zhì sǐ
sents.en: I'll fight to the death.

sents.zh: 尽管受了伤，他们还是继续战斗。
sents.p: jǐn guǎn shòu le shāng tā men hái shi jì xù zhàn dòu
sents.en: Though wounded, they continued to fight.

sents.zh: 一名伟大的战士威力显著，无需抵死奋战。
sents.p: yī míng wěi dà de zhàn shì wēi lì xiǎn zhù wú xū dǐ sǐ fèn zhàn
sents.en: A great warrior radiates strength. He doesn't have to fight to the death.

sents.zh: 你应该给他看看这装置。
sents.p: nǐ yīng gāi gěi tā kàn kàn zhè zhuāng zhì
sents.en: You should have shown him the device.

sents.zh: 我打赌他没搞定。
sents.p: wǒ dá dǔ tā méi gǎo dìng
sents.en: I bet he doesn't make it.

sents.zh: 我赌上我的名声。
sents.p: wǒ dǔ shǎng wǒ de míng shēng
sents.en: I'll stake my reputation on it.

sents.zh: 机器蒙上了一层灰。
sents.p: jī qì méng shǎng le yī céng huī
sents.en: The machine was coated with dust.

sents.zh: 不要被外貌蒙蔽了。
sents.p: bù yào bèi wài mào méng bì le
sents.en: Don't be fooled by appearances.

sents.zh: 这条裙子你穿着很合身。
sents.p: zhè tiáo qún zi nǐ chuān zhuó hěn hé shēn
sents.en: The dress fits you very well.

sents.zh: 他们都穿着制服。
sents.p: tā men dōu chuān zhuó zhì fú
sents.en: They were all dressed in uniforms.

sents.zh: 我承认，我不是世界上最整洁的人。
sents.p: wǒ chéng rèn wǒ bù shì shì jiè shǎng zuì zhěng jié de rén
sents.en: I admit I'm not the tidiest person in the world.

sents.zh: 没有女人的话，世界会是什么样？
sents.p: méi yǒu nǚ rén de huà shì jiè huì shì shén me yàng
sents.en: What would the world be like without women?

sents.zh: 我对外籍员工没有偏见。
sents.p: wǒ duì wài jí yuán gōng méi yǒu piān jiàn
sents.en: I don't have a prejudice against foreign workers.

sents.zh: 你可以问在那里玩耍的小孩。
sents.p: nǐ kě yǐ wèn zài nà li wán shuǎ de xiǎo hái
sents.en: You can ask the child who's playing over there.

sents.zh: 我小时候常常独自玩耍。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎo shí hou cháng cháng dú zì wán shuǎ
sents.en: I used to play alone when I was a child.

sents.zh: 我们会给你留个位置。
sents.p: wǒ men huì gěi nǐ liú gè wèi zhi
sents.en: We'll save a seat for you.

sents.zh: 不要把本末倒置。
sents.p: bù yào bǎ běn mò dào zhì
sents.en: Don't put the cart before the horse.

sents.zh: 你能告诉我红茶和绿茶的区别吗？
sents.p: nǐ néng gào sù wǒ hóng chá hé lǜ chá de qū bié ma
sents.en: Can you describe to me the difference between black tea and green tea?

sents.zh: 请问您能告诉我那家餐馆在哪吗？
sents.p: qǐng wèn nín néng gào sù wǒ nà jiā cān guǎn zài nǎ ma
sents.en: Can you please tell me where the restaurant is?

sents.zh: 为了救许多人牺牲一个人是否道德？
sents.p: wèi le jiù xǔ duō rén xī shēng yī gè rén shì fǒu dào dé
sents.en: Would it be ethical to sacrifice one person to save many?

sents.zh: 什么时候选举？
sents.p: shén me shí hou xuǎn jǔ
sents.en: When are the elections?

sents.zh: “你对市长选举怎么看？”“我不知道。”
sents.p: nǐ duì shì zhǎng xuǎn jǔ zěn me kàn wǒ bù zhī dào
sents.en: "What do you think of the election for mayor?" "I don't know."

sents.zh: 如果必要的话，我不反对付特别费用。
sents.p: rú guǒ bì yào de huà wǒ bù fǎn duì fù tè bié fèi yòng
sents.en: I have no objection to paying a special fee if it is necessary.

sents.zh: 我很抱歉给你惹来所有的这些麻烦。
sents.p: wǒ hěn bào qiàn gěi nǐ rě lái suǒ yǒu de zhè xiē má fan
sents.en: I'm sorry to cause you all this trouble.

sents.zh: 他的急脾气迟早会惹祸上身。
sents.p: tā de jí pí qi chí zǎo huì rě huò shǎng shēn
sents.en: His quick temper will get him in trouble one day.

sents.zh: 这个岛是孩子们的天堂。
sents.p: zhè gè dǎo shì hái zi men de tiān táng
sents.en: The island is a paradise for children.

sents.zh: 这个海滩是冲浪者的天堂。
sents.p: zhè gè hǎi tān shì chōng làng zhě de tiān táng
sents.en: This beach is a paradise for surfers.

sents.zh: 它像婴儿的屁股一样光滑。
sents.p: tā xiàng yīng ér de pì gu yī yàng guāng huá
sents.en: It's as smooth as a baby's bottom.

sents.zh: 这是你的布丁。
sents.p: zhè shì nǐ de bù dīng
sents.en: Here's your pudding.

sents.zh: 园丁后来发现就是凶手。
sents.p: yuán dīng hòu lái fā xiàn jiù shì xiōng shǒu
sents.en: The gardener turned out to be the murderer.

sents.zh: 警察起诉他盗窃。
sents.p: jǐng chá qǐ sù tā dào qiè
sents.en: The police accused him of theft.

sents.zh: 汤姆想学拳击，但他妈妈觉得这太危险了。
sents.p: tāng mǔ xiǎng xué quán jī dàn tā mā ma jué de zhè tài wēi xiǎn le
sents.en: Tom wants to learn boxing, but his mother thinks it's too dangerous.

sents.zh: 汤姆握紧了他的拳头。
sents.p: tāng mǔ wò jǐn le tā de quán tou
sents.en: Tom clenched his fists.

sents.zh: 感觉这不会有个好结局。
sents.p: gǎn jué zhè bù huì yǒu gè hǎo jié jú
sents.en: I feel like this isn't going to end well.

sents.zh: 上帝创造了世界
sents.p: shàng dì chuàng zào le shì jiè
sents.en: God created the world.

sents.zh: 那是原创的想法。
sents.p: nà shì yuán chuàng de xiǎng fǎ
sents.en: That's an original idea.

sents.zh: 我很惊讶，你竟然不知道他们结婚了。
sents.p: wǒ hěn jīng yà nǐ jìng rán bù zhī dào tā men jié hūn le
sents.en: I'm surprised that you don't know about their marriage.

sents.zh: 有志者事竟成。
sents.p: yǒu zhì zhě shì jìng chéng
sents.en: Where there's a will, there's a way.

sents.zh: 董事会一致决定任命她为执行总裁。
sents.p: dǒng shì huì yī zhì jué dìng rèn mìng tā wèi zhí xíng zǒng cái
sents.en: The board unanimously decided to appoint her as CEO.

sents.zh: 大爆炸致死六人。
sents.p: dà bào zhà zhì sǐ liù rén
sents.en: The huge explosion killed six people.

sents.zh: 我今晨看见一位天使。
sents.p: wǒ jīn chén kàn jiàn yī wèi tiān shǐ
sents.en: This morning, I saw an angel.

sents.zh: 你唱歌像天使。
sents.p: nǐ chàng gē xiàng tiān shǐ
sents.en: You sing like an angel.

sents.zh: 汤姆买了新专辑。
sents.p: tāng mǔ mǎi le xīn zhuān jí
sents.en: Tom bought the new album.

sents.zh: 他迈着稳健的步伐登上了山丘。
sents.p: tā mài zhe wěn jiàn de bù fá dēng shǎng le shān qiū
sents.en: He was walking up the hill at a steady pace.

sents.zh: 夜幕降临时，孩子们回家了。
sents.p: yè mù jiàng lín shí hái zi men huí jiā le
sents.en: The children returned home at dusk.

sents.zh: 我错过了奥运会的开幕式。
sents.p: wǒ cuò guò le aò yùn huì de kāi mù shì
sents.en: I missed the opening ceremony of the Olympics.

sents.zh: 我们必须调查医生的失踪案。
sents.p: wǒ men bì xū diào chá yī shēng de shī zōng àn
sents.en: We have to look into the disappearance of the doctor.

sents.zh: 失踪的猫还没被找到。
sents.p: shī zōng de māo hái méi bèi zhǎo dào
sents.en: The missing cat has not been found yet.

sents.zh: 汤姆没有注意到监控摄像头。
sents.p: tāng mǔ méi yǒu zhù yì dào jiān kòng shè xiàng tóu
sents.en: Tom didn't notice the surveillance camera.

sents.zh: 把手举起来！这是抢劫。
sents.p: bǎ shǒu jǔ qǐ lai zhè shì qiǎng jié
sents.en: Hands up! This is a robbery.

sents.zh: 你被抢劫过吗？
sents.p: nǐ bèi qiǎng jié guò ma
sents.en: Have you ever been robbed?

sents.zh: 让卫星环绕地球的是重力。
sents.p: ràng wèi xīng huán rào dì qiú de shì zhòng lì
sents.en: It's gravity that makes satellites move around the Earth.

sents.zh: 月球是地球唯一的卫星。
sents.p: yuè qiú shì dì qiú wéi yī de wèi xīng
sents.en: The moon is the earth's only satellite.

sents.zh: 风刮得太猛，他们没法在公园里玩了。
sents.p: fēng guā de tài měng tā men méi fǎ zài gōng yuán lǐ wán le
sents.en: The wind blew too hard for them to play in the park.

sents.zh: 别像猪一样猛吃东西。
sents.p: bié xiàng zhū yī yàng měng chī dōng xī
sents.en: Don't eat like a pig.

sents.zh: 我不想被牵扯到这件事里。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiǎng bèi qiān chě dào zhè jiàn shì lǐ
sents.en: I don't want to be involved in that matter.

sents.zh: 别再扯你姐姐的头发了！
sents.p: bié zài chě nǐ jiě jie de tóu fa le
sents.en: Stop pulling your sister's hair.

sents.zh: 你在监狱里呆了多久？
sents.p: nǐ zài jiān yù lǐ dāi le duō jiǔ
sents.en: How long were you in jail?

sents.zh: 你去过监狱吗？
sents.p: nǐ qù guò jiān yù ma
sents.en: Have you ever been in jail?

sents.zh: 不要根据封面来判断一本书。
sents.p: bù yào gēn jù fēng miàn lái pàn duàn yī běn shū
sents.en: Don't judge a book by its cover.

sents.zh: 我无法判断他的话是真是假。
sents.p: wǒ wú fǎ pàn duàn tā de huà shì zhēn shì jià
sents.en: I've no way of telling whether or not what he says is true.

sents.zh: 这个炸弹可以炸死很多人。
sents.p: zhè gè zhà dàn kě yǐ zhá sǐ hěn duō rén
sents.en: This bomb can kill many people.

sents.zh: 没有你这个城市孤单又冷清。
sents.p: méi yǒu nǐ zhè gè chéng shì gū dān yòu lěng qīng
sents.en: This city is cold and lonely without you.

sents.zh: 我孤单的时候总会想起他。
sents.p: wǒ gū dān de shí hou zǒng huì xiǎng qǐ tā
sents.en: I always think of him when I'm alone.

sents.zh: 我对中国宗教感兴趣。
sents.p: wǒ duì zhōng guó zōng jiào gǎn xìng qù
sents.en: I am interested in Chinese religion.

sents.zh: 我爸爸坚持要我去那地方看看。
sents.p: wǒ bà ba jiān chí yào wǒ qù nà dì fāng kàn kàn
sents.en: My father insisted that I should go to see the place.

sents.zh: 我对他的坚持感到很惊讶。
sents.p: wǒ duì tā de jiān chí gǎn dào hěn jīng yà
sents.en: I was surprised by his perseverance.

sents.zh: 他的名字在这个地区人尽皆知。
sents.p: tā de míng zi zài zhè gè dì qū rén jǐn jiē zhī
sents.en: His name is known to everybody in this area.

sents.zh: 凡人皆有得意时。

sents.en: I saw him caught by the police.

sents.p: liǎng guó dài biǎo tuán zài rì nèi wǎ huì miàn
sents.en: The delegations of both countries met in Geneva.

sents.zh: 我没什么可依靠的了。
sents.p: wǒ méi shén me kě yī kào de le
sents.en: I have nothing to fall back on.

sents.zh: 我们依然做得很好。
sents.p: wǒ men yī rán zuò de hěn hǎo
sents.en: We're still doing well.

sents.zh: 第一次攻击错过了目标。
sents.p: dì yī cì gōng jī cuò guò le mù biāo
sents.en: The first attack missed the target.

sents.zh: 我想学标准的英语。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng xué biāo zhǔn de yīng yǔ
sents.en: I want to learn standard English.

sents.zh: 你喜欢我的新发型吗？
sents.p: nǐ xǐ huan wǒ de xīn fà xíng ma
sents.en: Do you like my new haircut?

sents.zh: 汤姆很清楚我喜欢什么样的发型。
sents.p: tāng mǔ hěn qīng chu wǒ xǐ huan shén me yàng de fà xíng
sents.en: Tom knows exactly how I like my hair done.

sents.zh: 汤姆捐一半他的薪水给他最喜欢的慈善机构。
sents.p: tāng mǔ juān yī bàn tā de xīn shuǐ gěi tā zuì xǐ huan de cí shàn jī gòu
sents.en: Tom donates half his salary to his favorite charity.

sents.zh: 他把杯子掉到地板上打碎了。
sents.p: tā bǎ bēi zi diào dào dì bǎn shǎng dá suì le
sents.en: He dropped the cup and broke it.

sents.zh: 别让汤姆躺在地板上。
sents.p: bié ràng tāng mǔ tǎng zài dì bǎn shǎng
sents.en: Don't let Tom lie on the floor.

sents.zh: 你有鞋拔子吗？
sents.p: nǐ yǒu xié bá zǐ ma
sents.en: Do you have a shoehorn?

sents.zh: 学好一门外语需要坚韧不拔的毅力。
sents.p: xué hǎo yī mén wài yǔ xū yào jiān rèn bù bá de yì lì
sents.en: Mastering a foreign language involves a lot of patience.

sents.zh: 不过是一个文字游戏罢了。
sents.p: bù guò shì yī gè wén zì yóu xì bà le
sents.en: It's just a play on words.

sents.zh: 你还以为我作罢了，不是吗？
sents.p: nǐ hái yǐ wéi wǒ zuō bà le bù shì ma
sents.en: You thought I was through doing that, didn't you?

sents.zh: 哥伦布航行至遥远的西方，去寻找一个新大陆。
sents.p: gē lún bù háng xíng zhì yáo yuǎn de xī fāng qù xún zhǎo yī gè xīn dà lù
sents.en: Columbus sailed farther west to look for a new continent.

sents.zh: 在医院的时候，我不得不戒烟。
sents.p: zài yī yuàn de shí hou wǒ bù dé bù jiè yān
sents.en: I had to abstain from smoking while I was in the hospital.

sents.zh: 如果你想活得久一点就戒烟。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ xiǎng huó de jiǔ yī diǎn jiù jiè yān
sents.en: Quit smoking if you don't want to die early.

sents.zh: 嘴里有东西的时候不准说话。
sents.p: zuǐ lǐ yǒu dōng xī de shí hou bù zhǔn shuō huà
sents.en: Don't talk with your mouth full.

sents.zh: 该名青年将少女从流氓团伙中救了出来。
sents.p: gāi míng qīng nián jiāng shào nǚ cóng liú máng tuán huǒ zhōng jiù le chū lái
sents.en: The young man saved the girl from a bunch of hoodlums.

sents.zh: 这老人瞎了一只眼。
sents.p: zhè lǎo rén xiā le yī zhǐ yǎn
sents.en: The old man is blind in one eye.

sents.zh: 那狗一只眼是瞎的。
sents.p: nà gǒu yī zhǐ yǎn shì xiā de
sents.en: The dog is blind in one eye.

sents.zh: 他像极了他父亲，这让我震惊。
sents.p: tā xiàng jí le tā fù qīn zhè ràng wǒ zhèn jīng
sents.en: I was surprised at his strong resemblance to his father.

sents.zh: 我们都很震惊。
sents.p: wǒ men dōu hěn zhèn jīng
sents.en: We were all pretty shocked.

sents.zh: 他们把他奉为领袖。
sents.p: tā men bǎ tā fèng wèi lǐng xiù
sents.en: They looked up to him as their leader.

sents.zh: 请把电视机关掉好吗？
sents.p: qǐng bǎ diàn shì jī guān diào hǎo ma
sents.en: Would you please turn off the TV?

sents.zh: 你该上床了。把收音机关了。
sents.p: nǐ gāi shǎng chuáng le bǎ shōu yīn jī guān le
sents.en: It's time you went to bed. Turn off the radio.

sents.zh: 那个孩子可能在回家的路上被绑架了。
sents.p: nà gè hái zi kě néng zài huí jiā de lù shang bèi bǎng jià le
sents.en: That child may have been kidnapped on his way home.

sents.zh: 我被外星人绑架了。
sents.p: wǒ bèi wài xīng rén bǎng jià le
sents.en: I was abducted by aliens.

sents.zh: 看到这笔钱使他被诱惑偷东西。
sents.p: kàn dào zhè bǐ qián shǐ tā bèi yòu huò tōu dōng xī
sents.en: The sight of the money tempted him into stealing.

sents.zh: 我抵抗不了甜食的诱惑。
sents.p: wǒ dǐ kàng bù liǎo tián shí de yòu huò
sents.en: I can't resist sweet things.

sents.zh: 今天是情人节
sents.p: jīn tiān shì qíng rén jiē
sents.en: Today is Valentine's Day.

sents.zh: 不要嫉妒其他人的成功。
sents.p: bù yào jí dù qí tā rén de chéng gōng
sents.en: You must not be jealous of others' success.

sents.zh: 他们嫉妒我们的成功。
sents.p: tā men jí dù wǒ men de chéng gōng
sents.en: They are jealous of our success.

sents.zh: 那些都是好迹象。
sents.p: nà xiē dōu shì hǎo jì xiàng
sents.en: Those are encouraging signs.

sents.zh: 汤姆日夜兼程。
sents.p: tāng mǔ rì yè jiān chéng
sents.en: Tom is on the go day and night.

sents.zh: 在夏季，我每天早上都会洗个澡。
sents.p: zài xià jì wǒ měi tiān zǎo shang dū huì xǐ gè zǎo
sents.en: I take a bath every morning in the summer.

sents.zh: 我每天吃过晚饭后都会学法语。
sents.p: wǒ měi tiān chī guò wǎn fàn hòu dū huì xué fǎ yǔ
sents.en: I study French after dinner every day.

sents.zh: 他们知道如何制造原子弹。
sents.p: tā men zhī dào rú hé zhì zào yuán zǐ dàn
sents.en: They know how to make an atomic bomb.

sents.zh: 我有许多唱片。
sents.p: wǒ yǒu xǔ duō chàng piàn
sents.en: I have many discs.

sents.zh: 没有人明白为什么大象突然攻击了它的主人。
sents.p: méi yǒu rén míng bai wèi shén me dà xiàng tū rán gōng jī le tā de zhǔ rén
sents.en: Nobody understood why the elephant suddenly turned on its owner.

sents.zh: 发言人的评论极有攻击性。
sents.p: fā yán rén de píng lùn jí yǒu gōng jī xìng
sents.en: The speaker's comments were highly offensive.

sents.zh: 他编造了一个借口。
sents.p: tā biān zào le yī gè jiè kǒu
sents.en: He thought up an excuse.

sents.zh: 我没有任何借口。
sents.p: wǒ méi yǒu rèn hé jiè kǒu
sents.en: I don't have an excuse.

sents.zh: 只有和平能够拯救世界。
sents.p: zhǐ yǒu hé píng néng gòu zhěng jiù shì jiè
sents.en: Only peace can save the world.

sents.zh: 我们能拯救这颗星球吗？
sents.p: wǒ men néng zhěng jiù zhè kē xīng qiú ma
sents.en: Can we save the planet?

sents.zh: 塞纳河穿越了巴黎。
sents.p: sāi nà hé chuān yuè le ba lí
sents.en: The Seine flows through Paris.

sents.zh: 她抛弃了她的孩子。
sents.p: tā pāo qì le tā de hái zi
sents.en: She abandoned her children.

sents.zh: 汤姆抛弃了他们。
sents.p: tāng mǔ pāo qì le tā men
sents.en: Tom abandoned them.

sents.zh: 她看上去十分优雅。
sents.p: tā kàn shang qu shí fēn yōu yǎ
sents.en: She looks very elegant.

sents.zh: 海啸的警报解除了。
sents.p: hǎi xiào de jǐng bào jiě chú le
sents.en: The tsunami alert was cancelled.

units.title: Academic humanities
units.intro: Grammar focus: Lectures and essays on history and philosophy; summarizing an argument

ex.zh: 我没有一个同学住在这儿附近。
ex.p: wǒ méi yǒu yī gè tóng xué zhù zài zhèr fù jìn
ex.en: None of my classmates live near here.

ex.zh: 你在附近看见过一只咖啡色的钱包吗？
ex.p: nǐ zài fù jìn kàn jiàn guò yī zhǐ kā fēi sè de qián bāo ma
ex.en: Did you see a brown wallet around here?

ex.zh: 凶手还没有抓到。
ex.p: xiōng shǒu hái méi yǒu zhuā dào
ex.en: The murderer is still at large.

ex.zh: 园丁后来发现就是凶手。
ex.p: yuán dīng hòu lái fā xiàn jiù shì xiōng shǒu
ex.en: The gardener turned out to be the murderer.

ex.zh: 喝醉的驾驶员对车祸有责任。
ex.p: hē zuì de jià shǐ yuán duì chē huò yǒu zé rèn
ex.en: A drunk driver was responsible for the car accident.

ex.zh: 我母亲有驾照，但是她不开车。
ex.p: wǒ mǔ qīn yǒu jià zhào dàn shì tā bù kāi chē
ex.en: My mother has a driver's license, but she doesn't drive.

items.en: to invite; to provoke; to demand or ask for

ex.zh: 我很讨厌有女的说：“男人都一样”。
ex.p: wǒ hěn tǎo yàn yǒu nǚ de shuō nán rén dōu yī yàng
ex.en: I hate it when women say that all men are the same.

ex.zh: 让我们和他们讨论这个问题吧。
ex.p: ràng wǒ men hé tā men tǎo lùn zhè gè wèn tí ba
ex.en: Let's discuss the problem with them.

items.en: to help; to support; to aid

ex.zh: 他的援助真是雪中送炭。
ex.p: tā de yuán zhù zhēn shì xuě zhōng sòng tàn
ex.en: His help has been invaluable.

items.en: to infringe on; to encroach on; to violate

ex.zh: 不要侵犯她的隐私。
ex.p: bù yào qīn fàn tā de yǐn sī
ex.en: Don't intrude on her privacy.

ex.zh: 他侵犯了她的隐私。
ex.p: tā qīn fàn le tā de yǐn sī
ex.en: He intruded on her privacy.

items.en: career; life (way in which sb lives); period of one's life

ex.zh: 你最好不要熬夜。
ex.p: nǐ zuì hǎo bù yào áo yè
ex.en: You'd better not stay up late.

ex.zh: 我们习惯熬夜。
ex.p: wǒ men xí guàn áo yè
ex.en: We're used to staying up late.

items.en: to auction; auction sale; to sell at a reduced price

ex.zh: 汤姆名义上市公司的领导。他儿子做所有重大决策。
ex.p: tāng mǔ míng yì shàng shì gōng sī de lǐng dǎo tā ér zi zuò suǒ yǒu zhòng dà jué cè
ex.en: Tom is the head of the company in name only. His son makes all the important decisions.

ex.zh: 汤姆出了桩事故。
ex.p: tāng mǔ chū le zhuāng shì gù
ex.en: Tom had a bad accident.

items.en: to get in touch with; to contact; to stay in contact (with)

ex.zh: 我跟父母联络了一下。
ex.p: wǒ gēn fù mǔ lián luò le yī xià
ex.en: I contacted my parents.

ex.zh: 让我们保持联络。
ex.p: ràng wǒ men bǎo chí lián luò
ex.en: Let's keep in touch.

ex.zh: 为什么你企图逃走？
ex.p: wèi shén me nǐ qǐ tú táo zǒu
ex.en: Why did you try to run away?

ex.zh: 汤姆不企图回应。
ex.p: tāng mǔ bù qǐ tú huí yìng
ex.en: Tom didn't attempt to reply.

items.en: nest; pit or hollow on the human body; lair

ex.zh: 我房间是个猪窝。
ex.p: wǒ fáng jiān shì gè zhū wō
ex.en: My room is a pigsty.

ex.zh: 金窝银窝不如自己的狗窝。
ex.p: jīn wō yín wō bù rú zì jǐ de gǒu wō
ex.en: Be it ever so humble, there's no place like home.

items.en: on stage; to go on stage; to take the field
to pray; to say one's prayers; prayer

ex.zh: 他每天祈祷好几次。
ex.p: tā měi tiān qí dǎo hǎo jī cì
ex.en: He prays several times a day.

ex.zh: 大家来一起祈祷吧。
ex.p: dà jiā lái yī qǐ qí dǎo ba
ex.en: Let's all pray together.

items.en: to destroy; to spoil; to ruin

ex.zh: 他跟她说这样的话真是太残忍了。
ex.p: tā gēn tā shuō zhè yàng de huà zhēn shì tài cán rěn le
ex.en: It is cruel of him to say such things to her.

ex.zh: 我昨天生病了。
ex.p: wǒ zuó tiān shēng bìng le
ex.en: I was ill yesterday.

ex.zh: 棕色不是汤姆天生的发色。
ex.p: zōng sè bù shì tāng mǔ tiān shēng de fā sè
ex.en: Brown is not Tom's natural hair color.

items.en: must; to have to; to wait

ex.zh: 我必须在礼拜六之前把书还回去。
ex.p: wǒ bì xū zài lǐ bài liù zhī qián bǎ shū hái huí qu
ex.en: I have to give back the book before Saturday.

ex.zh: 我必须停止吃那么甜的冰激凌。
ex.p: wǒ bì xū tíng zhǐ chī nà me tián de bīng jī líng
ex.en: I've got to stop eating such sweet ice cream.

ex.zh: 从山上走来一只巨大的怪物。
ex.p: cóng shān shǎng zǒu lái yī zhǐ jù dà de guài wu
ex.en: A huge monster is coming down the mountain.

items.en: to land; to come ashore; to make landfall (of typhoon etc)

ex.zh: 我丢了我的灵感。
ex.p: wǒ diū le wǒ de líng gǎn
ex.en: I lost my inspiration.

ex.zh: 什么是您最大的灵感来源？
ex.p: shén me shì nín zuì dà de líng gǎn lái yuán
ex.en: What is your greatest source of inspiration?

ex.zh: 他假装听不见。
ex.p: tā jiǎ zhuāng yǐn bù jiàn
ex.en: He pretended not to be listening.

ex.zh: 她假装不在意。
ex.p: tā jiǎ zhuāng bù zài yì
ex.en: She assumed an air of indifference.

items.en: edge; fringe; verge; brink; periphery; marginal; borderline
respectful; to respect; to offer politely

ex.zh: 她非常尊敬她的老师。
ex.p: tā fēi cháng zūn jìng tā de lǎo shī
ex.en: She respects her teacher a lot.

ex.zh: 年轻人应该尊敬老人。
ex.p: nián qīng rén yīng gāi zūn jìng lǎo rén
ex.en: The young should respect the old.

ex.zh: 那些是真钻石吗？
ex.p: nà xiē shì zhēn zuàn shí ma
ex.en: Are those real diamonds?

ex.zh: 那不是一颗真正的钻石，对吗？
ex.p: nà bù shì yī kē zhēn zhèng de zuàn shí duì ma
ex.en: That's not a real diamond, is it?

ex.zh: 他们被直升机解救。
ex.p: tā men bèi zhí shēng jī jiě jiù
ex.en: They were rescued by helicopter.

ex.zh: 语言学是门很有意思的学科。
ex.p: yǔ yán xué shì mén hěn yǒu yì si de xué kē
ex.en: Linguistics is a very interesting field.

ex.zh: 外国人真有意思，不是吗？
ex.p: wài guó rén zhēn yǒu yì si bù shì ma
ex.en: Foreigners are interesting, aren't they?

items.en: to rub; to grind; to polish

ex.zh: 我试着消磨时间。
ex.p: wǒ shì zhe xiāo mó shí jiān
ex.en: I was trying to kill time.

ex.zh: 你磨蹭什么呀，快点去吧。
ex.p: nǐ mó cèng shén me ya kuài diǎn qù ba
ex.en: What are you lingering for? Hurry up and go.

ex.zh: 汤姆赤裸着上身。
ex.p: tāng mǔ chì luǒ zhe shǎng shēn
ex.en: Tom is naked from the waist up.

ex.zh: 男孩赤裸着上身。
ex.p: nán hái chì luǒ zhe shǎng shēn
ex.en: The boy was shirtless.

items.en: to rule (a country); to govern; rule

ex.zh: 有些人说日本是个男性统治的社会。
ex.p: yǒu xiē rén shuō rì běn shì gè nán xìng tǒng zhì de shè huì
ex.en: Some people say Japan is a male-dominated society.

ex.zh: 我敲门，但是没有人回应。
ex.p: wǒ qiāo mén dàn shì méi yǒu rén huí yìng
ex.en: I knocked on the door, but nobody answered.

ex.zh: 汤姆有回应了吗？
ex.p: tāng mǔ yǒu huí yìng le ma
ex.en: Did Tom reply?

ex.zh: 在这种暑天里我宁愿呆在家也不出去。
ex.p: zài zhè zhǒng shǔ tiān lǐ wǒ nìng yuàn dāi zài jiā yě bù chū qù
ex.en: I would rather stay at home than go out in this hot weather.

ex.zh: 他宁愿不吃这个。
ex.p: tā nìng yuàn bù chī zhè gè
ex.en: He'd prefer not to eat that.

items.en: to do one's utmost; with all one's might; at all costs; (to work or fight) as if

ex.zh: 他为了孩子的幸福，拼命的工作。
ex.p: tā wèi le hái zi de xìng fú pīn mìng de gōng zuò
ex.en: He worked hard to make his child happy.

ex.zh: 可能你工作得太拼命？
ex.p: kě néng nǐ gōng zuò de tài pīn mìng
ex.en: Maybe you're working too hard.

items.en: to screen (a movie); to stage (a play); a screening
to suffer a fracture; (of a bone) to break; fracture

ex.zh: 上帝保佑美国。
ex.p: shàng dì bǎo yòu měi guó
ex.en: God bless America.

items.en: to excise; to cut out (a tumor)

ex.zh: 汤姆被欺负了。
ex.p: tāng mǔ bèi qī fu le
ex.en: Tom was bullied.

items.en: to escape; to evade; to avoid

ex.zh: 你只会逃避生活问题。
ex.p: nǐ zhǐ huì táo bì shēng huó wèn tí
ex.en: You're just running away from life's problems.

ex.zh: 没人能逃避死亡。
ex.p: méi rén néng táo bì sǐ wáng
ex.en: Nobody can avoid death.

ex.zh: 记住我的级别在你的之上。
ex.p: jì zhu wǒ de jí bié zài nǐ de zhī shǎng
ex.en: Remember that I outrank you.

ex.zh: 科学家们还不知道怎么治疗癌症。
ex.p: kē xué jiā men hái bù zhī dào zěn me zhì liáo ái zhèng
ex.en: Scientists haven't found a cure for cancer yet.

ex.zh: 科学家们还没有找到癌症的治疗方法。
ex.p: kē xué jiā men hái méi yǒu zhǎo dào ái zhèng de zhì liáo fāng fǎ
ex.en: Scientists haven't found a cure for cancer yet.

items.en: to offer; to present; to dedicate

ex.zh: 我每三个月献一次血。
ex.p: wǒ měi sān gè yuè xiàn yī cì xuè
ex.en: I donate blood every three months.

ex.zh: 你不能成为献血者。
ex.p: nǐ bù néng chéng wéi xiàn xuè zhě
ex.en: You can't be a blood donor.

ex.zh: 他们收养了那个孤儿。

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 7–9 · 第136单元

Academic humanities

Grammar focus: Lectures and essays on history and philosophy; summarizing an argument

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

lessons.title: 回应、不可思议、宁愿、联赛…
飞船、孤儿、无论如何、正当…

sents.zh: 我没有一个同学住在这儿附近。
sents.p: wǒ méi yǒu yī gè tóng xué zhù zài zhèr fù jìn
sents.en: None of my classmates live near here.

sents.zh: 你在附近看见过一只咖啡色的钱包吗？
sents.p: nǐ zài fù jìn kàn jiàn guò yī zhǐ kā fēi sè de qián bāo ma
sents.en: Did you see a brown wallet around here?

sents.zh: 凶手还没有抓到。
sents.p: xiōng shǒu hái méi yǒu zhuā dào
sents.en: The murderer is still at large.

sents.zh: 园丁后来发现就是凶手。
sents.p: yuán dīng hòu lái fā xiàn jiù shì xiōng shǒu
sents.en: The gardener turned out to be the murderer.

sents.zh: 喝醉的驾驶员对车祸有责任。
sents.p: hē zuì de jià shǐ yuán duì chē huò yǒu zé rèn
sents.en: A drunk driver was responsible for the car accident.

sents.zh: 我母亲有驾照，但是她不开车。
sents.p: wǒ mǔ qīn yǒu jià zhào dàn shì tā bù kāi chē
sents.en: My mother has a driver's license, but she doesn't drive.

sents.zh: 我很讨厌有女的说：“男人都一样”。
sents.p: wǒ hěn tǎo yàn yǒu nǚ de shuō nán rén dōu yī yàng
sents.en: I hate it when women say that all men are the same.

sents.zh: 让我们和他们讨论这个问题吧。
sents.p: ràng wǒ men hé tā men tǎo lùn zhè gè wèn tí ba
sents.en: Let's discuss the problem with them.

sents.zh: 他的援助真是雪中送炭。
sents.p: tā de yuán zhù zhēn shì xuě zhōng sòng tàn
sents.en: His help has been invaluable.

sents.zh: 不要侵犯她的隐私。
sents.p: bù yào qīn fàn tā de yǐn sī
sents.en: Don't intrude on her privacy.

sents.zh: 他侵犯了她的隐私。
sents.p: tā qīn fàn le tā de yǐn sī
sents.en: He intruded on her privacy.

sents.zh: 你最好不要熬夜。
sents.p: nǐ zuì hǎo bù yào áo yè
sents.en: You'd better not stay up late.

sents.zh: 我们习惯熬夜。
sents.p: wǒ men xí guàn áo yè
sents.en: We're used to staying up late.

sents.en: Tom is the head of the company in name only. His son makes all the important decisions.

sents.zh: 汤姆出了桩事故。
sents.p: tāng mǔ chū le zhuāng shì gù
sents.en: Tom had a bad accident.

sents.zh: 我跟父母联络了一下。
sents.p: wǒ gēn fù mǔ lián luò le yī xià
sents.en: I contacted my parents.

sents.zh: 让我们保持联络。
sents.p: ràng wǒ men bǎo chí lián luò
sents.en: Let's keep in touch.

sents.zh: 为什么你企图逃走？
sents.p: wèi shén me nǐ qǐ tú táo zǒu
sents.en: Why did you try to run away?

sents.zh: 汤姆不企图回应。
sents.p: tāng mǔ bù qǐ tú huí yìng
sents.en: Tom didn't attempt to reply.

sents.zh: 我房间是个猪窝。
sents.p: wǒ fáng jiān shì gè zhū wō
sents.en: My room is a pigsty.

sents.zh: 金窝银窝不如自己的狗窝。
sents.p: jīn wō yín wō bù rú zì jǐ de gǒu wō
sents.en: Be it ever so humble, there's no place like home.

sents.p: tā měi tiān qí dǎo hǎo jī cì
sents.en: He prays several times a day.

sents.zh: 大家来一起祈祷吧。

sents.en: Let's all pray together.

sents.zh: 他跟她说这样的话真是太残忍了。

sents.en: Brown is not Tom's natural hair color.

sents.p: wǒ bì xū zài lǐ bài liù zhī qián bǎ shū hái huí qu

sents.en: You should run for city council.

sents.zh: 所有人都屏住呼吸关注着谁会赢得总统竞选。

sents.en: Everyone held their breath to see who would win the presidential election.

sents.zh: 因为风暴，他们晚到了。
sents.p: yīn wèi fēng bào tā men wǎn dào le
sents.en: They arrived late because of the storm.

sents.zh: 今天许多学校因为风暴停课。
sents.p: jīn tiān xǔ duō xué xiào yīn wèi fēng bào tíng kè
sents.en: Many schools are closed today because of the storm.

sents.p: wǒ xiǎng chè huí wǒ zhī qián de chén shù

sents.zh: 汤姆戴着手套。
sents.p: tāng mǔ dài zhuó shǒu tào
sents.en: Tom is wearing gloves.

sents.zh: 你不能指望他们的帮助。
sents.p: nǐ bù néng zhǐ wàng tā men de bāng zhù
sents.en: You can't count on their help.

sents.zh: 我们没指望过他在那么短的时间里完成工作。
sents.p: wǒ men méi zhǐ wàng guò tā zài nà me duǎn de shí jiān lǐ wán chéng gōng zuò

sents.zh: 他完成了他的使命。
sents.p: tā wán chéng le tā de shǐ mìng
sents.en: He accomplished his mission.

sents.zh: 我真的很倒霉！
sents.p: wǒ zhēn de hěn dǎo méi
sents.en: How unlucky I am!

sents.zh: 傻瓜才会那么干。
sents.p: shǎ guā cái huì nà me gàn
sents.en: Only a fool would do something like that.

sents.zh: 别把人家当傻瓜。
sents.p: bié bǎ rén jiā dāng shǎ guā
sents.en: Don't make a fool of me.

sents.zh: 我不是有意要保密的。
sents.p: wǒ bù shì yǒu yì yào bǎo mì de
sents.en: I didn't mean to keep it secret.

sents.zh: 有时候口误对政治家来说是致命的。
sents.p: yǒu shí hou kǒu wù duì zhèng zhì jiā lái shuō shì zhì mìng de
sents.en: A slip of the tongue is sometimes fatal to a politician.

sents.zh: 这是世界上最美妙的声音。
sents.p: zhè shì shì jiè shǎng zuì měi miào de shēng yīn
sents.en: That's the most beautiful sound in the world.

sents.zh: 她真的有本事让别人做她想做的事。
sents.p: tā zhēn de yǒu běn shì ràng bié ren zuò tā xiǎng zuò de shì
sents.en: She has a real knack for getting people to do what she wants.

sents.zh: 汤姆看来难缠。
sents.p: tāng mǔ kàn lai nán chán
sents.en: Tom seems tough.

sents.zh: 半途而废是你所能做的最糟糕的事情。

sents.en: Leaving something unfinished is the worst thing you can do.

sents.zh: 废水经常污染海洋。
sents.p: fèi shuǐ jīng cháng wū rǎn hǎi yáng

sents.zh: 服务器下线了。
sents.p: fú wù qì xià xiàn le
sents.en: The server was down.

sents.zh: 它的滋味真的很好。
sents.p: tā de zī wèi zhēn de hěn hǎo
sents.en: It tastes really good.

sents.zh: 在这个城市，白人和黑人间的争端愈演愈烈。
sents.p: zài zhè gè chéng shì bái rén hé hēi rén jiān de zhēng duān yù yǎn yù liè
sents.en: The conflict between blacks and whites in the city became worse.

sents.zh: 我要一间有淋浴的单人间。
sents.p: wǒ yào yī jiān yǒu lín yù de shàn rén jiān
sents.en: I'd like a single with a shower, please.

sents.zh: 情况丝毫没有改变。
sents.p: qíng kuàng sī háo méi yǒu gǎi biàn
sents.en: The situation hasn't changed at all.

sents.zh: 美驻留在看的那个人的眼里。
sents.p: měi zhù liú zài kàn de nà gè rén de yǎn lǐ
sents.en: Beauty's in the eye of the beholder.

sents.zh: 先下手为强，后下手遭殃。
sents.p: xiān xià shǒu wèi qiáng hòu xià shǒu zāo yāng
sents.en: Get them before they get us.

sents.zh: 墙上沾满了血。
sents.p: qiáng shǎng zhān mǎn le xuè
sents.en: The walls are covered with blood.

sents.zh: 这好比大海捞针。
sents.p: zhè hǎo bǐ dà hǎi lāo zhēn
sents.en: It is like looking for a needle in a haystack.

sents.zh: 我觉得我们老板很蠢，这我就只跟你说。
sents.p: wǒ jué de wǒ men lǎo bǎn hěn chǔn zhè wǒ jiù zhǐ gēn nǐ shuō
sents.en: Between you and me, I think our boss is stupid.

sents.zh: 我必须问你一个蠢问题。
sents.p: wǒ bì xū wèn nǐ yī gè chǔn wèn tí
sents.en: I need to ask you a silly question.

sents.zh: 市长否认收受了贿赂。
sents.p: shì zhǎng fǒu rèn shōu shòu le huì lù
sents.en: The mayor denied having taken a bribe.

sents.zh: 不存在没有阴影的光明，也不存在没有光明的阴影。
sents.p: bù cún zài méi yǒu yīn yǐng de guāng míng yě bù cún zài méi yǒu guāng míng de yīn yǐng
sents.en: There's no light without shade, and no shade without light.

sents.zh: 样本不够纯净。
sents.p: yàng běn bù gòu chún jìng
sents.en: The sample isn't pure enough.

sents.zh: 汤姆见证了所有发生的事情。
sents.p: tāng mǔ jiàn zhèng le suǒ yǒu fā shēng de shì qing
sents.en: Tom saw everything that happened.

sents.zh: 昨天强盗闯进了店里。
sents.p: zuó tiān qiáng dào chuǎng jìn le diàn lǐ
sents.en: A burglar broke into the shop yesterday.

sents.zh: 你喜欢盗版电影吗？
sents.p: nǐ xǐ huan dào bǎn diàn yǐng ma
sents.en: Do you like pirate movies?

sents.zh: 医学的最新进展颇为显著。
sents.p: yī xué de zuì xīn jìn zhǎn pō wèi xiǎn zhù
sents.en: The recent advances in medicine are remarkable.

sents.zh: 他很小心地溜出房间，以免惊醒她。
sents.p: tā hěn xiǎo xīn de liū chū fáng jiān yǐ miǎn jīng xǐng tā
sents.en: He crept out of the room very carefully to avoid waking her up.

sents.zh: 过去我们每个周末都去溜冰。
sents.p: guò qù wǒ men měi gè zhōu mò dōu qù liū bīng
sents.en: We used to go skating every weekend.

sents.zh: 他全家都在农场工作。
sents.p: tā quán jiā dōu zài nóng chǎng gōng zuò
sents.en: All of his family work on a farm.

sents.zh: 我住在离波士顿不远的一个农场。
sents.p: wǒ zhù zài chī bō shì dùn bù yuǎn de yī gè nóng chǎng
sents.en: I live on a farm not too far from Boston.

sents.zh: 我在给魔鬼当辩护士。
sents.p: wǒ zài gěi mó guǐ dāng biàn hù shì
sents.en: I'm just playing the devil's advocate.

sents.zh: 他表现的像个疯子。
sents.p: tā biǎo xiàn de xiàng gè fēng zi
sents.en: He acted like a madman.

sents.zh: 小镇被暴风雨后的洪水摧毁了。
sents.p: xiǎo zhèn bèi bào fēng yǔ hòu de hóng shuǐ cuī huǐ le
sents.en: The town was destroyed by the flood after the storm.

sents.zh: 摧毁这个寺庙。
sents.p: cuī huǐ zhè gè sì miào
sents.en: Destroy this temple.

sents.zh: 但愿我是一个好歌手。
sents.p: dàn yuàn wǒ shì yī gè hǎo gē shǒu
sents.en: I wish I were a good singer.

sents.zh: 但愿我能找到在我的博客上屏蔽评论的办法。
sents.p: dàn yuàn wǒ néng zhǎo dào zài wǒ de bó kè shǎng píng bì píng lùn de bàn fǎ
sents.en: I wish I could figure out how to disable comments on my blog.

sents.zh: 你有个温馨的家庭。
sents.p: nǐ yǒu gè wēn xīn de jiā tíng
sents.en: You have a very nice family.

sents.zh: 世界上许多人在挨饿。
sents.p: shì jiè shǎng xǔ duō rén zài āi è
sents.en: Many people are suffering from hunger around the world.

sents.zh: 我过了难挨的一天。
sents.p: wǒ guò le nán āi de yī tiān
sents.en: I had a hard day.

sents.zh: 罪犯没有放人质们走。
sents.p: zuì fàn méi yǒu fàng rén zhì men zǒu
sents.en: The criminal didn't let the hostages go.

lessons.html:
HSK 7–9 · 第139单元

Academic humanities

Grammar focus: Lectures and essays on history and philosophy; summarizing an argument

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.en: I get chapped lips every winter.

sents.zh: 你的嘴唇很漂亮。
sents.p: nǐ de zuǐ chún hěn piào liang
sents.en: You have beautiful lips.

sents.zh: 他们被老师训斥了。
sents.p: tā men bèi lǎo shī xùn chì le
sents.en: They were scolded by the teacher.

sents.zh: 你该结束这种愚蠢的行为了。
sents.p: nǐ gāi jié shù zhè zhǒng yú chǔn de xíng wéi le
sents.en: You must put an end to this foolish behavior.

sents.zh: 那是我说过的最愚蠢的话了。
sents.p: nà shì wǒ shuō guò de zuì yú chǔn de huà le
sents.en: That's the stupidest thing I've ever said.

sents.zh: 我们走开的时候，房子被盗窃了。
sents.p: wǒ men zǒu kāi de shí hou fáng zi bèi dào qiè le
sents.en: Our house was robbed while we were away.

sents.zh: 一个入室盗窃者趁我去旅游的时候闯入了我家。
sents.p: yī gè rù shì dào qiè zhě chèn wǒ qù lǚ yóu de shí hou chuǎng rù le wǒ jiā
sents.en: A burglar broke into my house while I was away on a trip.

sents.zh: 几十个年轻人参加了示威游行。
sents.p: jī shí gè nián qīng rén cān jiā le shì wēi yóu xíng
sents.en: Dozens of young people attended the demonstration.

sents.zh: 我要参加一个示威游行。
sents.p: wǒ yào cān jiā yī gè shì wēi yóu xíng
sents.en: I'm going to join a demonstration.

sents.zh: 我觉得她有点自私。
sents.p: wǒ jué de tā yǒu diǎn zì sī
sents.en: It seems to me that she is a little selfish.

sents.zh: 自私不是我的本意。
sents.p: zì sī bù shì wǒ de běn yì
sents.en: I didn't mean to be selfish.

sents.zh: 我们所有人凑份子给老师买生日礼物。
sents.p: wǒ men suǒ yǒu rén còu fèn zǐ gěi lǎo shī mǎi shēng rì lǐ wù
sents.en: We all chipped in to buy our teacher a birthday present.

sents.zh: 你需要两个才能凑成一对。
sents.p: nǐ xū yào liǎng gè cái néng còu chéng yī duì
sents.en: You need two to make a pair.

sents.zh: 不要放松警惕。
sents.p: bù yào fàng sōng jǐng tì
sents.en: Don't let your guard down.

sents.zh: 我斩钉截铁地拒绝了。
sents.p: wǒ zhǎn dīng jié tiě de jù jué le
sents.en: I flatly refused.

sents.zh: 他们抵御入侵者，保卫了国家。
sents.p: tā men dǐ yù rù qīn zhě bǎo wèi le guó jiā
sents.en: They defended their country against the invaders.

sents.zh: 我发觉男孩儿酣然入睡了。
sents.p: wǒ fā jué nán háir hān rán rù shuì le
sents.en: I found the boy fast asleep.

sents.zh: 汤姆从他的绘画本上撕下了一页。
sents.p: tāng mǔ cóng tā de huì huà běn shǎng sī xià le yī xié
sents.en: Tom ripped a page out of his sketch book.

sents.zh: 汤姆把这一页撕掉了。
sents.p: tāng mǔ bǎ zhè yī xié sī diào le
sents.en: Tom ripped out the page.

sents.zh: 汤姆真是个大笨蛋。
sents.p: tāng mǔ zhēn shì gè dà bèn dàn
sents.en: Tom is such an idiot.

sents.zh: 我的兄弟是个笨蛋。
sents.p: wǒ de xiōng dì shì gè bèn dàn
sents.en: My brother is an idiot.

sents.zh: 巨大的柱子遮住了视线，让人看不到湖。
sents.p: jù dà de zhù zi zhē zhù le shì xiàn ràng rén kàn bù dào hú
sents.en: A large pillar obstructs the view of the lake.

sents.zh: 我在海边捡了个漂亮贝壳。
sents.p: wǒ zài hǎi biān jiǎn le gè piào liang bèi ké
sents.en: I picked up a pretty shell at the seaside.

sents.zh: 蛋壳容易破碎。
sents.p: dàn qiào róng yì pò suì
sents.en: The shell of an egg is easily broken.

sents.zh: 汤姆甚至连怎么煎鸡蛋都不知道。
sents.p: tāng mǔ shèn zhì lián zěn me jiān jī dàn dōu bù zhī dào
sents.en: Tom doesn't even know how to fry an egg.

sents.zh: 我们早餐做了煎饼。
sents.p: wǒ men zǎo cān zuò le jiān bǐng
sents.en: We made pancakes for breakfast.

sents.zh: 如果我们不继续赶路，我们会迟到的。
sents.p: rú guǒ wǒ men bù jì xù gǎn lù wǒ men huì chí dào de
sents.en: If we don't keep walking, we'll be late.

sents.zh: 价格还会继续涨吗？
sents.p: jià gé hái huì jì xù zhǎng ma
sents.en: Will the price keep going up?

sents.zh: 我接种了流感疫苗。
sents.p: wǒ jiē zhǒng le liú gǎn yì miáo
sents.en: I had a flu shot.

sents.zh: 有很多工人被困在煤矿里了。
sents.p: yǒu hěn duō gōng rén bèi kùn zài méi kuàng lǐ le
sents.en: Many workers were trapped in the coal mine.

sents.zh: 他把身子靠在胳膊上。
sents.p: tā bǎ shēn zi kào zài gē bo shǎng
sents.en: He leaned on his elbows.

sents.zh: 她给他织了件毛衣。
sents.p: tā gěi tā zhī le jiàn máo yī
sents.en: She knit him a sweater.

sents.zh: 我想撤回我之前的陈述。
sents.p: wǒ xiǎng chè huí wǒ zhī qián de chén shù
sents.en: I would like to retract my previous statement.

sents.zh: 从上周三起，她一直缺席。
sents.p: cóng shàng zhōu sān qǐ tā yī zhí quē xí
sents.en: She has been absent since last Wednesday.

sents.zh: 他受邀做俱乐部的主席。
sents.p: tā shòu yāo zuò jù lè bù de zhǔ xí
sents.en: He was invited to be the chairman of the club.

sents.zh: 我不知道他来这里的确切时间。
sents.p: wǒ bù zhī dào tā lái zhè lǐ dí què qiē shí jiān
sents.en: I don't know for certain when he will come.

sents.zh: 我不确定确切的日期。
sents.p: wǒ bù què dìng què qiè de rì qī
sents.en: I'm not sure of the exact date.

sents.zh: 我对汤姆发誓我不会说任何话了。
sents.p: wǒ duì tāng mǔ fā shì wǒ bù huì shuō rèn hé huà le
sents.en: I promised Tom I wouldn't say anything.

sents.zh: 我能发誓这箱子里有东西。
sents.p: wǒ néng fā shì zhè xiāng zi lǐ yǒu dōng xī
sents.en: I could swear there's something inside this box.

sents.zh: 让我安心工作。
sents.p: ràng wǒ ān xīn gōng zuò
sents.en: Let me work in peace.

sents.zh: 这是我和汤姆最困惑的部分。
sents.p: zhè shì wǒ hé tāng mǔ zuì kùn huò de bù fen
sents.en: That was the part that Tom and I were most confused about.

sents.zh: 我有一点困惑了。
sents.p: wǒ yǒu yī diǎn kùn huò le
sents.en: I'm a little confused.

sents.zh: 我今晚能借你的数码相机吗？
sents.p: wǒ jīn wǎn néng jiè nǐ de shù mǎ xiàng jī ma
sents.en: Can I borrow your digital camera tonight?

sents.zh: 他善用他的天赋。
sents.p: tā shàn yòng tā de tiān fù
sents.en: He makes good use of his talents.

sents.zh: 什么是格式塔疗法？
sents.p: shén me shì gé shì tǎ liáo fǎ
sents.en: What is Gestalt Therapy?

sents.zh: 事故过后，汤姆觉得停止滑冰了。
sents.p: shì gù guò hòu tāng mǔ jué de tíng zhǐ huá bīng le
sents.en: After the accident, Tom decided to stop skating.

sents.zh: 他给我们讲了一个有趣的故事。
sents.p: tā gěi wǒ men jiǎng le yī gè yǒu qù de gù shì
sents.en: He told us an interesting story.

sents.zh: 士兵们占领了这个建筑。
sents.p: shì bīng men zhàn lǐng le zhè gè jiàn zhù
sents.en: The soldiers occupied the building.

sents.zh: 很快，城市就被士兵占领了。
sents.p: hěn kuài chéng shì jiù bèi shì bīng zhàn lǐng le
sents.en: The city was soon occupied by the soldiers.

sents.zh: 我从没见过那么壮丽的日落景色。
sents.p: wǒ cóng méi jiàn guò nà me zhuàng lì de rì là jǐng sè
sents.en: I've never seen such a beautiful sunset.

sents.zh: 汤姆是个很强壮的人。
sents.p: tāng mǔ shì gè hěn qiáng zhuàng de rén
sents.en: Tom is a strong guy.

sents.zh: 我不想辞去这份工作。
sents.p: wǒ bù xiǎng cí qù zhè fèn gōng zuò
sents.en: I don't want to quit this job.

sents.zh: 我只跟你说，我很快就要辞掉我现在的工作了。
sents.p: wǒ zhǐ gēn nǐ shuō wǒ hěn kuài jiù yào cí diào wǒ xiàn zài de gōng zuò le
sents.en: Between you and me, I'm going to quit my present job soon.

sents.zh: 我是倒数第二个得知这个坏消息的。
sents.p: wǒ shì dào shǔ dì èr gè dé zhī zhè gè huài xiāo xi de
sents.en: I was the second to last person to hear the bad news.

sents.zh: 她总是在班上拿倒数第一。
sents.p: tā zǒng shì zài bān shǎng ná dào shǔ dì yī
sents.en: She is always at the bottom of the class.

sents.zh: 我送给汤姆一份临别礼物
sents.p: wǒ sòng gěi tāng mǔ yī fèn lín bié lǐ wù
sents.en: I gave Tom a going-away present.

sents.zh: 正式工比临时工要好。
sents.p: zhèng shì gōng bǐ lín shí gōng yào hǎo
sents.en: A permanent job is better than a temporary one.

sents.zh: 我的口罩在哪？
sents.p: wǒ de kǒu zhào zài nǎ
sents.en: Where's my mask?

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 7–9 · 第140单元

Academic humanities

Grammar focus: Lectures and essays on history and philosophy; summarizing an argument

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 你得留意一下。
sents.p: nǐ de liú yì yī xià
sents.en: You must keep your eyes open.

sents.zh: 咬指甲是个坏习惯。
sents.p: yǎo zhǐ jia shì gè huài xí guàn
sents.en: Biting your fingernails is a bad habit.

sents.zh: 不要再咬指甲了。
sents.p: bù yào zài yǎo zhǐ jia le
sents.en: Stop biting your nails.

sents.zh: 一口气吹灭生日蛋糕上所有的蜡烛。
sents.p: yī kǒu qì chuī miè shēng rì dàn gāo shǎng suǒ yǒu de là zhú
sents.en: Blow out all the candles on the birthday cake at once.

sents.zh: 老人咽下了最后一口气。
sents.p: lǎo rén yān xià le zuì hòu yī kǒu qì
sents.en: The old man breathed his last.

sents.zh: 我不愿意勾起久远的回忆。
sents.p: wǒ bù yuàn yì gōu qǐ jiǔ yuǎn de huí yì
sents.en: I don't want to stir up old memories.

sents.zh: 汤姆穿着他的制服。
sents.p: tāng mǔ chuān zhuó tā de zhì fú
sents.en: Tom is wearing his uniform.

sents.zh: 汤姆换上制服。
sents.p: tāng mǔ huàn shǎng zhì fú
sents.en: Tom changed into his uniform.

sents.zh: 当我回到家的时候，我妹妹正在弹吉他。
sents.p: dāng wǒ huí dào jiā de shí hou wǒ mèi mei zhèng zài dàn jí tā
sents.en: When I came home, my sister was playing the guitar.

sents.zh: 这吉他太贵了，我没法买下。
sents.p: zhè jí tā tài guì le wǒ méi fǎ mǎi xià
sents.en: This guitar is so expensive that I can't buy it.

sents.zh: 那个男人在一周前死于肺癌。
sents.p: nà gè nán rén zài yī zhōu qián sǐ yú fèi ái
sents.en: That man died of lung cancer a week ago.

sents.zh: 这五年痛苦的癌症治疗他终于坚持下来了。
sents.p: zhè wǔ nián tòng kǔ de ái zhèng zhì liáo tā zhōng yú jiān chí xià lai le
sents.en: Throughout the five years of painful cancer treatments, he managed to keep a stiff upper lip.

sents.zh: 我会把它看作一个征兆。
sents.p: wǒ huì bǎ tā kàn zuò yī gè zhēng zhào
sents.en: I'd take it as a sign.

sents.zh: 乌云是下雨的征兆。
sents.p: wū yún shì xià yǔ de zhēng zhào
sents.en: Dark clouds are a sign of rain.

sents.zh: 美国是一个自称没有社会阶层的国家。
sents.p: měi guó shì yī gè zì chēng méi yǒu shè huì jiē céng de guó jiā
sents.en: America likes to claim that it is a "classless" society.

sents.zh: 汤姆告诉我他很乐意帮助。
sents.p: tāng mǔ gào sù wǒ tā hěn lè yì bāng zhù
sents.en: Tom told me he'd love to help.

sents.zh: 汤姆说他乐意做这事。
sents.p: tāng mǔ shuō tā lè yì zuò zhè shì
sents.en: Tom said he'd be willing to do this.

sents.zh: 我的母亲只是默默地哭泣。
sents.p: wǒ de mǔ qīn zhǐ shì mò mò de kū qì
sents.en: My mother did nothing but weep.

sents.zh: 警察瞄准了那个男人。
sents.p: jǐng chá miáo zhǔn le nà gè nán rén
sents.en: The policeman aimed his gun at the man.

sents.zh: 猎人们用枪瞄准了大象。
sents.p: liè rén men yòng qiāng miáo zhǔn le dà xiàng
sents.en: The hunters aimed at the elephant.

sents.zh: 汤姆不能掩饰他的失望。
sents.p: tāng mǔ bù néng yǎn shì tā de shī wàng
sents.en: Tom couldn't conceal his disappointment.

sents.zh: 我不能掩饰我的心情。
sents.p: wǒ bù néng yǎn shì wǒ de xīn qíng
sents.en: I can't hide my feelings.

sents.zh: 她没有试图掩盖真相。
sents.p: tā méi yǒu shì tú yǎn gài zhēn xiàng
sents.en: She didn't try to hide the truth.

sents.zh: 汤姆拿起罐子读标签。
sents.p: tāng mǔ ná qǐ guàn zǐ dòu biāo qiān
sents.en: Tom picked up the jar and read the label.

sents.zh: 科学家们正努力终结艾滋病。
sents.p: kē xué jiā men zhēng nǔ lì zhōng jié ài zī bìng
sents.en: Scientists are working hard to put an end to AIDS.

sents.zh: 我知道怎么设陷阱。
sents.p: wǒ zhī dào zěn me shè xiàn jǐng
sents.en: I know how to set a trap.

sents.zh: 这对双胞胎长得一模一样。
sents.p: zhè duì shuāng bāo tāi cháng de yī mú yī yàng
sents.en: Those twins look like two peas in a pod.

sents.zh: 她用手捂住了电话的话筒。
sents.p: tā yòng shǒu wǔ zhù le diàn huà de huà tǒng
sents.en: She covered the mouthpiece of the phone with her hand.

sents.zh: 我的父亲总是干涉我的私生活。
sents.p: wǒ de fù qīn zǒng shì gān shè wǒ de sī shēng huó
sents.en: My father is always poking his nose into my private life.

sents.zh: 记者没有犹豫地去干涉了人们的私生活。
sents.p: jì zhě méi yǒu yóu yù de qù gān shè le rén men de sī shēng huó
sents.en: Reporters do not hesitate to intrude into people's privacy.

sents.zh: 幕后操纵者是谁？
sents.p: mù hòu cāo zòng zhě shì shéi
sents.en: Who's behind it?

sents.zh: 试着用积极的态度去面对任何事情。
sents.p: shì zhe yòng jī jí de tài du qù miàn duì rèn hé shì qing
sents.en: Try to have a positive attitude about everything.

sents.zh: 事故似乎和厚厚的积雪有关。
sents.p: shì gù sì hū hé hòu hòu de jī xuě yǒu guān
sents.en: The accident seemed to have something to do with the heavy snow.

sents.zh: 我们做这事没有额外报酬。
sents.p: wǒ men zuò zhè shì méi yǒu é wài bào chou
sents.en: We won't get paid extra for doing this.

sents.zh: 这工作报酬很高。
sents.p: zhè gōng zuò bào chou hěn gāo
sents.en: This job pays pretty well.

sents.zh: 他看起来很可疑。
sents.p: tā kàn qǐ lai hěn kě yí
sents.en: He looks suspicious.

sents.zh: 看上去很可疑。
sents.p: kàn shang qu hěn kě yí
sents.en: It looks suspicious.

sents.zh: 她用茶匙搅她的咖啡。
sents.p: tā yòng chá shi jiǎo tā de kā fēi
sents.en: She stirred her coffee with a teaspoon.

sents.zh: 那声音搅了我的美梦。
sents.p: nà shēng yīn jiǎo le wǒ de měi mèng
sents.en: My sleep was disturbed by the sound.

sents.zh: 他的耐心已经到了极限。
sents.p: tā de nài xīn yǐ jīng dào le jí xiàn
sents.en: His patience is worn out.

sents.zh: 你不该违背你的诺言。
sents.p: nǐ bù gāi wéi bèi nǐ de nuò yán
sents.en: You shouldn't break promises.

sents.zh: 汤姆是糖尿病患者。
sents.p: tāng mǔ shì táng niào bìng huàn zhě
sents.en: Tom's diabetic.

sents.zh: 事故差点让他丢了性命。
sents.p: shì gù chà diǎn ràng tā diū le xìng mìng
sents.en: The accident almost cost him his life.

sents.zh: 汤姆在表达自己的意见的时候总是很慌张。
sents.p: tāng mǔ zài biǎo dá zì jǐ de yì jiàn de shí hou zǒng shì hěn huāng zhāng
sents.en: Tom never felt comfortable expressing his own opinion.

sents.zh: 已经不需要再伪装了。
sents.p: yǐ jīng bù xū yào zài wěi zhuāng le
sents.en: There's no need to pretend anymore.

sents.zh: 他气喘吁吁的。
sents.p: tā qì chuǎn yù yù de
sents.en: He was out of breath.

sents.zh: 他是个吸毒男。
sents.p: tā shì gè xī dú nán
sents.en: He's a meth addict.

sents.zh: 或许你就应该把汤姆开除掉。
sents.p: huò xǔ nǐ jiù yīng gāi bǎ tāng mǔ kāi chú diào
sents.en: Maybe you should just fire Tom.

sents.zh: 我们决定不开除你。
sents.p: wǒ men jué dìng bù kāi chú nǐ
sents.en: We've decided not to fire you.

sents.zh: 她把他从烂泥中拽出来了。
sents.p: tā bǎ tā cóng làn ní zhōng yè chū lái le
sents.en: She pulled him out of the mud.

sents.zh: 他们被埋在一座大坟墓里。
sents.p: tā men bèi mái zài yī zuò dà fén mù lǐ
sents.en: They were buried in a mass grave.

sents.zh: 他发言完后，大家陷入了沉默。
sents.p: tā fā yán wán hòu dà jiā xiàn rù le chén mò
sents.en: When he finished speaking, everyone was silent.

units.title: Science and technology
units.intro: Grammar focus: Popular-science articles, AI and the internet; explaining a process in writing

items.en: to tremble; to shake out; to reveal

ex.p: wǒ de shǒu dǒu de tài lì hai méi fǎ chuān zhēn le
ex.en: My hands were shaking too much to thread the needle.

frost; white powder or cream spread over a surface; frosting

ex.zh: 今天早上下厚霜了。
ex.p: jīn tiān zǎo shang xià hòu shuāng le
ex.en: We had a heavy frost this morning.

ex.zh: 你不想涂防晒霜是你的问题，但是晒伤了不要来抱怨。
ex.p: nǐ bù xiǎng tú fáng shài shuāng shì nǐ de wèn tí dàn shì shài shāng le bù yào lái bào yuàn
ex.en: If you don't want to put on sunscreen, that's your problem. Just don't come complaining to me when you get a sunburn.

ex.zh: 今天早上我耳朵流血了。
ex.p: jīn tiān zǎo shang wǒ ěr duo liú xuè le
ex.en: My ear was bleeding this morning.

ex.zh: 我开始流血了。
ex.p: wǒ kāi shǐ liú xuè le

items.en: to respond to an emergency; to meet a contingency; (attributive) emergency

ex.zh: 他是非常有想像力的作家。
ex.p: tā shì fēi cháng yǒu xiǎng xiàng lì de zuò jiā
ex.en: He is a very imaginative writer.

ex.zh: 他被卷进了是非中。
ex.p: tā bèi juǎn jìn le shì fēi zhōng
ex.en: He was involved in the trouble.

items.en: to lose consciousness; to be in a coma; stupor

ex.zh: 患者现在处于深度昏迷状态。
ex.p: huàn zhě xiàn zài chǔ yú shēn dù hūn mí zhuàng tài
ex.en: The patient is in a deep coma.

ex.zh: 汤姆正昏迷不醒。
ex.p: tāng mǔ zhēng hūn mí bù xǐng
ex.en: Tom's out cold.

items.en: to work; to operate; to revolve

ex.zh: 这些机器目前不运转。
ex.p: zhè xiē jī qì mù qián bù yùn zhuǎn
ex.en: These machines aren't working now.

items.en: young and tender; (of food) tender; lightly cooked; (of color) light

ex.zh: 你觉得汤姆是不是太嫩了？
ex.p: nǐ jué de tāng mǔ shì bù shì tài nèn le
ex.en: Do you think Tom is too young?

items.en: to drift about; to wander; to roam

ex.zh: 我们在沙滩上起了火。
ex.p: wǒ men zài shā tān shǎng qǐ le huǒ
ex.en: We built a fire on the beach.

ex.zh: 我把我的手枪指向了目标。
ex.p: wǒ bǎ wǒ de shǒu qiāng zhǐ xiàng le mù biāo
ex.en: I aimed my gun at the target.

ex.zh: 他对一个生病的男人说这种事真是没良心。
ex.p: tā duì yī gè shēng bìng de nán rén shuō zhè zhǒng shì zhēn shì méi liáng xīn
ex.en: It was heartless of him to say such a thing to the sick man.

items.en: to offer for sale; to sell; to sell out; to betray

ex.zh: 一个真正的绅士不会出卖他的朋友。
ex.p: yī gè zhēn zhèng de shēn shì bù huì chū mài tā de péng you
ex.en: A true gentleman never betrays his friends.

ex.zh: 魔术师吸引了孩子们的注意。
ex.p: mó shù shī xī yǐn le hái zi men de zhù yì
ex.en: The magician had the children's attention.

ex.zh: 汤姆是个专业的魔术师。
ex.p: tāng mǔ shì gè zhuān yè de mó shù shī
ex.en: Tom is a professional magician.

items.en: to stand out from the masses (idiom)

ex.zh: 汤姆有什么很与众不同的地方吗？
ex.p: tāng mǔ yǒu shén me hěn yǔ zhòng bù tóng de dì fāng ma
ex.en: What's so special about Tom?

ex.zh: 我以前总认为汤姆是有一些与众不同的。
ex.p: wǒ yǐ qián zǒng rèn wéi tāng mǔ shì yǒu yī xiē yǔ zhòng bù tóng de
ex.en: I always thought that Tom was a bit different.

ex.zh: 我把咖啡倒翻在地毯上了。
ex.p: wǒ bǎ kā fēi dào fān zài dì tǎn shǎng le
ex.en: I spilled my coffee on the carpet.

ex.zh: 这块地毯是手工制作的。
ex.p: zhè kuài dì tǎn shì shǒu gōng zhì zuò de
ex.en: This rug is handmade.

ex.zh: 这个公司二分之三的雇员是工程师。
ex.p: zhè gè gōng sī èr fēn zhī sān de gù yuán shì gōng chéng shī
ex.en: Two thirds of the employees of this company are engineers.

ex.zh: 你们不能解雇我们。
ex.p: nǐ men bù néng jiě gù wǒ men
ex.en: You can't fire us.

ex.zh: 我总觉得木偶戏有点吓人。
ex.p: wǒ zǒng jué de mù ǒu xì yǒu diǎn xià rén
ex.en: I always find puppet shows a bit creepy.

items.en: rays of light; brilliant rays; radiance

ex.zh: 孩子们非常喜欢在海滩上玩耍。
ex.p: hái zi men fēi cháng xǐ huan zài hǎi tān shǎng wán shuǎ
ex.en: Children really like playing on the beach.

ex.zh: 我在海滩上发现了一个漂亮的贝壳。
ex.p: wǒ zài hǎi tān shǎng fā xiàn le yī gè piào liang de bèi ké
ex.en: I found a beautiful shell on the shore.

ex.zh: 电池要额外付钱。
ex.p: diàn chí yào é wài fù qián
ex.en: You need to pay extra for the batteries.

ex.zh: 我们做这事没有额外报酬。
ex.p: wǒ men zuò zhè shì méi yǒu é wài bào chou
ex.en: We won't get paid extra for doing this.

items.en: to constrain or repress emotions; oppressive; stifling

ex.zh: 汤姆没法压抑自己的怒火了。
ex.p: tāng mǔ méi fǎ yā yì zì jǐ de nù huǒ le
ex.en: Tom couldn't hold back his anger.

items.en: to forge; to fake; to counterfeit

ex.zh: 这是一个伪造品。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè wěi zào pǐn
ex.en: It's a fake.

ex.zh: 我亲眼见到了它。
ex.p: wǒ qīn yǎn jiàn dào le tā
ex.en: I saw it with my own eyes.

ex.zh: 我妹妹亲眼看到它了。
ex.p: wǒ mèi mei qīn yǎn kàn dào tā le
ex.en: My sister saw it with her own eyes.

items.en: to disturb; to cause a commotion; to harass
pattern; way of doing sth; trick
to choke; to stifle; to restrain
