ex.p: tā qù nián huán qiú lǚ xíng
ex.en: She traveled around the world last year.

ex.zh: 他们任命他为经理。
ex.p: tā men rèn mìng tā wèi jīng lǐ
ex.en: They appointed him as a director.

ex.zh: 他是这么的无情。
ex.p: tā shì zhè me de wú qíng
ex.en: He is so heartless.

ex.zh: 这是一个狗咬狗的无情世界。
ex.p: zhè shì yī gè gǒu yǎo gǒu de wú qíng shì jiè

to begin; to open; to start

ex.zh: 那个药的话没有处方是买不到的。
ex.p: nà gè yào de huà méi yǒu chǔ fāng shì mǎi bù dào de

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 7–9 · 第141单元

Science and technology

Grammar focus: Popular-science articles, AI and the internet; explaining a process in writing

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

lessons.title: 会诊、不正之风、核能、健壮…
心安理得、养生、正气、一鼓作气…

sents.zh: 激光打印机一般比喷墨打印机用起来更省钱。
sents.p: jī guāng dǎ yìn jī yī bān bǐ pēn mò dǎ yìn jī yòng qǐ lai gēng shěng qián
sents.en: Laser printers are generally cheaper to maintain than inkjet printers.

sents.zh: 如果有人把事情抖出来，我就麻烦了。
sents.p: rú guǒ yǒu rén bǎ shì qing dǒu chū lái wǒ jiù má fan le
sents.en: I'll be in trouble if the story gets out.

sents.zh: 我的手抖得太厉害，没法穿针了。
sents.p: wǒ de shǒu dǒu de tài lì hai méi fǎ chuān zhēn le
sents.en: My hands were shaking too much to thread the needle.

sents.zh: 今天早上下厚霜了。
sents.p: jīn tiān zǎo shang xià hòu shuāng le
sents.en: We had a heavy frost this morning.

sents.zh: 你不想涂防晒霜是你的问题，但是晒伤了不要来抱怨。
sents.p: nǐ bù xiǎng tú fáng shài shuāng shì nǐ de wèn tí dàn shì shài shāng le bù yào lái bào yuàn
sents.en: If you don't want to put on sunscreen, that's your problem. Just don't come complaining to me when you get a sunburn.

sents.zh: 今天早上我耳朵流血了。
sents.p: jīn tiān zǎo shang wǒ ěr duo liú xuè le
sents.en: My ear was bleeding this morning.

sents.zh: 我开始流血了。
sents.p: wǒ kāi shǐ liú xuè le
sents.en: I've started bleeding.

sents.zh: 他是非常有想像力的作家。
sents.p: tā shì fēi cháng yǒu xiǎng xiàng lì de zuò jiā
sents.en: He is a very imaginative writer.

sents.zh: 他被卷进了是非中。
sents.p: tā bèi juǎn jìn le shì fēi zhōng
sents.en: He was involved in the trouble.

sents.zh: 患者现在处于深度昏迷状态。
sents.p: huàn zhě xiàn zài chǔ yú shēn dù hūn mí zhuàng tài
sents.en: The patient is in a deep coma.

sents.zh: 汤姆正昏迷不醒。
sents.p: tāng mǔ zhēng hūn mí bù xǐng
sents.en: Tom's out cold.

sents.zh: 这些机器目前不运转。
sents.p: zhè xiē jī qì mù qián bù yùn zhuǎn
sents.en: These machines aren't working now.

sents.zh: 你觉得汤姆是不是太嫩了？
sents.p: nǐ jué de tāng mǔ shì bù shì tài nèn le
sents.en: Do you think Tom is too young?

sents.zh: 我们在沙滩上起了火。
sents.p: wǒ men zài shā tān shǎng qǐ le huǒ
sents.en: We built a fire on the beach.

sents.zh: 我把我的手枪指向了目标。
sents.p: wǒ bǎ wǒ de shǒu qiāng zhǐ xiàng le mù biāo
sents.en: I aimed my gun at the target.

sents.zh: 他对一个生病的男人说这种事真是没良心。
sents.p: tā duì yī gè shēng bìng de nán rén shuō zhè zhǒng shì zhēn shì méi liáng xīn
sents.en: It was heartless of him to say such a thing to the sick man.

sents.zh: 一个真正的绅士不会出卖他的朋友。
sents.p: yī gè zhēn zhèng de shēn shì bù huì chū mài tā de péng you
sents.en: A true gentleman never betrays his friends.

sents.zh: 魔术师吸引了孩子们的注意。
sents.p: mó shù shī xī yǐn le hái zi men de zhù yì
sents.en: The magician had the children's attention.

sents.zh: 汤姆是个专业的魔术师。
sents.p: tāng mǔ shì gè zhuān yè de mó shù shī
sents.en: Tom is a professional magician.

sents.zh: 汤姆有什么很与众不同的地方吗？
sents.p: tāng mǔ yǒu shén me hěn yǔ zhòng bù tóng de dì fāng ma
sents.en: What's so special about Tom?

sents.zh: 我以前总认为汤姆是有一些与众不同的。
sents.p: wǒ yǐ qián zǒng rèn wéi tāng mǔ shì yǒu yī xiē yǔ zhòng bù tóng de
sents.en: I always thought that Tom was a bit different.

sents.zh: 我把咖啡倒翻在地毯上了。
sents.p: wǒ bǎ kā fēi dào fān zài dì tǎn shǎng le
sents.en: I spilled my coffee on the carpet.

sents.zh: 这块地毯是手工制作的。
sents.p: zhè kuài dì tǎn shì shǒu gōng zhì zuò de
sents.en: This rug is handmade.

sents.zh: 这个公司二分之三的雇员是工程师。
sents.p: zhè gè gōng sī èr fēn zhī sān de gù yuán shì gōng chéng shī
sents.en: Two thirds of the employees of this company are engineers.

sents.zh: 你们不能解雇我们。
sents.p: nǐ men bù néng jiě gù wǒ men
sents.en: You can't fire us.

sents.zh: 我总觉得木偶戏有点吓人。
sents.p: wǒ zǒng jué de mù ǒu xì yǒu diǎn xià rén
sents.en: I always find puppet shows a bit creepy.

sents.zh: 孩子们非常喜欢在海滩上玩耍。
sents.p: hái zi men fēi cháng xǐ huan zài hǎi tān shǎng wán shuǎ
sents.en: Children really like playing on the beach.

sents.zh: 我在海滩上发现了一个漂亮的贝壳。
sents.p: wǒ zài hǎi tān shǎng fā xiàn le yī gè piào liang de bèi ké
sents.en: I found a beautiful shell on the shore.

sents.zh: 电池要额外付钱。
sents.p: diàn chí yào é wài fù qián
sents.en: You need to pay extra for the batteries.

sents.zh: 我们做这事没有额外报酬。
sents.p: wǒ men zuò zhè shì méi yǒu é wài bào chou
sents.en: We won't get paid extra for doing this.

sents.zh: 汤姆没法压抑自己的怒火了。
sents.p: tāng mǔ méi fǎ yā yì zì jǐ de nù huǒ le
sents.en: Tom couldn't hold back his anger.

sents.zh: 这是一个伪造品。
sents.p: zhè shì yī gè wěi zào pǐn
sents.en: It's a fake.

sents.zh: 我亲眼见到了它。
sents.p: wǒ qīn yǎn jiàn dào le tā
sents.en: I saw it with my own eyes.

sents.zh: 我妹妹亲眼看到它了。
sents.p: wǒ mèi mei qīn yǎn kàn dào tā le
sents.en: My sister saw it with her own eyes.

sents.zh: 她去年环球旅行。
sents.p: tā qù nián huán qiú lǚ xíng
sents.en: She traveled around the world last year.

sents.zh: 他们任命他为经理。
sents.p: tā men rèn mìng tā wèi jīng lǐ
sents.en: They appointed him as a director.

sents.zh: 他是这么的无情。
sents.p: tā shì zhè me de wú qíng
sents.en: He is so heartless.

sents.zh: 这是一个狗咬狗的无情世界。
sents.p: zhè shì yī gè gǒu yǎo gǒu de wú qíng shì jiè
sents.en: It's a dog-eat-dog world.

sents.zh: 那个药的话没有处方是买不到的。
sents.p: nà gè yào de huà méi yǒu chǔ fāng shì mǎi bù dào de
sents.en: You can't buy this medicine without a prescription.

sents.zh: 经济在复苏之中。
sents.p: jīng jì zài fù sū zhī zhōng
sents.en: The economy is picking up.

sents.zh: 再检查一下汤姆的脉搏。
sents.p: zài jiǎn chá yī xià tāng mǔ de mài bó
sents.en: Check Tom's pulse again.

sents.zh: 我的脉搏很快。
sents.p: wǒ de mài bó hěn kuài
sents.en: My pulse is fast.

sents.zh: 她每星期去作一次健美操。
sents.p: tā měi xīng qī qù zuō yī cì jiàn měi cāo
sents.en: She goes to aerobics once a week.

units.title: Science and technology
units.intro: Grammar focus: Popular-science articles, AI and the internet; explaining a process in writing

items.en: to put up with; to tolerate

ex.zh: 那女士容忍了那男人。
ex.p: nà nǚ shì róng rěn le nà nán rén
ex.en: The lady tolerated the man.

ex.zh: 你能容忍他做事的方式么？
ex.p: nǐ néng róng rěn tā zuò shì de fāng shì me
ex.en: Can you put up with the way he behaves?

items.en: to invite; to request; to intercept

ex.zh: 她邀请我们去她的生日派对。
ex.p: tā yāo qǐng wǒ men qù tā de shēng rì pài duì
ex.en: She invited us to her birthday party.

ex.zh: 我邀请他去派对，他接受了。
ex.p: wǒ yāo qǐng tā qù pài duì tā jiē shòu le
ex.en: I invited him to the party and he accepted.

ex.zh: 章鱼小丸子真的很美味！
ex.p: zhāng yú xiǎo wán zǐ zhēn de hěn měi wèi
ex.en: Takoyaki is really quite delicious.

items.en: to believe firmly; without any doubt
to toss from side to side (e.g. sleeplessly)

ex.zh: 汤姆是个不寻常的人。
ex.p: tāng mǔ shì gè bù xún cháng de rén
ex.en: Tom is an extraordinary man.

items.en: early in the morning; at dawn

ex.zh: 我们同意了第二天一早开始。
ex.p: wǒ men tóng yì le dì èr tiān yī zǎo kāi shǐ
ex.en: We agreed to start early the next morning.

items.en: pocket; bag; to wrap up or hold in a bag
to disguise oneself as; to dress up; to play (a role)

ex.zh: 他扮演哈姆雷特的角色。
ex.p: tā bàn yǎn hā mǔ léi tè de jué sè
ex.en: He played the part of Hamlet.

items.en: to hope for; to long for; to expect

ex.zh: 汤姆的上司真的非常生气。
ex.p: tāng mǔ de shàng si zhēn de fēi cháng shēng qì
ex.en: Tom's boss was really angry.

ex.zh: 如果你有上司的话，学会尊敬他（她）。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ yǒu shàng si de huà xué huì zūn jìng tā tā
ex.en: Be respectful to your superiors, if you have any.

ex.zh: 这是我们的荣幸。
ex.p: zhè shì wǒ men de róng xìng
ex.en: It's our pleasure.

ex.zh: 汤姆往他的吐司上放了许多蜂蜜。
ex.p: tāng mǔ wǎng tā de tǔ sī shǎng fàng le xǔ duō fēng mì
ex.en: Tom put a lot of honey on his toast.

ex.zh: 汤姆往他的面包片上放了许多蜂蜜。
ex.p: tāng mǔ wǎng tā de miàn bāo piān shǎng fàng le xǔ duō fēng mì
ex.en: Tom put a lot of honey on his toast.

ex.zh: 汤姆和我不是抱怨的人。
ex.p: tāng mǔ hé wǒ bù shì bào yuàn de rén
ex.en: Tom and I weren't the ones who complained.

ex.zh: 她抱怨我的薪水很低。
ex.p: tā bào yuàn wǒ de xīn shuǐ hěn dī
ex.en: She complained that my salary was low.

items.en: roar of laughter (onom.); hubbub; to roar (as a crowd)
to lie; to tell an untruth

ex.zh: 会为你说谎的人，就会对你说谎。
ex.p: huì wèi nǐ shuō huǎng de rén jiù huì duì nǐ shuō huǎng
ex.en: People who will lie for you, will lie to you.

ex.zh: 父母教育他们的孩子说谎是不好的。
ex.p: fù mǔ jiào yù tā men de hái zi shuō huǎng shì bù hǎo de
ex.en: Parents teach their children that it's wrong to lie.

items.en: to recall; to recollect; to think back

ex.zh: 这让我感到沮丧。
ex.p: zhè ràng wǒ gǎn dào jǔ sàng
ex.en: It makes me feel sad.

ex.zh: 汤姆有点沮丧。
ex.p: tāng mǔ yǒu diǎn jǔ sàng
ex.en: Tom is a little depressed.

items.en: to excavate; to explore; (fig.) to unearth
to inform; to notify; to announce
a way out (lit. and fig.); opportunity for advancement; a way forward

ex.zh: 那是唯一的出路。
ex.p: nà shì wéi yī de chū lù
ex.en: It was the only way to go.

ex.zh: 人们说爱情是盲目的。
ex.p: rén men shuō ài qíng shì máng mù de
ex.en: They say love is blind.

ex.zh: 恋爱使人盲目。
ex.p: liàn ài shǐ rén máng mù
ex.en: Love is blind.

ex.zh: 他迟早会回来的。
ex.p: tā chí zǎo huì huí lai de
ex.en: He will come back sooner or later.

ex.zh: 他的急脾气迟早会惹祸上身。
ex.p: tā de jí pí qi chí zǎo huì rě huò shǎng shēn
ex.en: His quick temper will get him in trouble one day.

ex.zh: 没人解得了这个谜题。
ex.p: méi rén xiè dé le zhè gè mèi tí
ex.en: No one could solve the puzzle.

ex.zh: 你解开谜团了吗？
ex.p: nǐ jiě kāi mí tuán le ma
ex.en: Have you worked the puzzle out?

items.en: sufficient; full; to fill; to serve as; to act as

ex.zh: 我们有充裕的时间赶上火车。
ex.p: wǒ men yǒu chōng yù de shí jiān gǎn shàng huǒ chē
ex.en: We have ample time to catch our train.

ex.zh: 你的理由很充分。
ex.p: nǐ de lǐ yóu hěn chōng fèn
ex.en: Your reason is very good.

items.en: the more...(the more...); to recover; to heal

ex.zh: 在这个城市，白人和黑人间的争端愈演愈烈。
ex.p: zài zhè gè chéng shì bái rén hé hēi rén jiān de zhēng duān yù yǎn yù liè
ex.en: The conflict between blacks and whites in the city became worse.

items.en: to conceal from; to keep (sb) in the dark

ex.zh: 你是不是瞒着我什么？
ex.p: nǐ shì bù shì mán zhe wǒ shén me
ex.en: Are you hiding something?

ex.zh: 我常常能分辨出来一个人是不是瞒着我什么事情。
ex.p: wǒ cháng cháng néng fēn biàn chū lái yī gè rén shì bù shì mán zhe wǒ shén me shì qing
ex.en: I can usually tell when someone is hiding something from me.

items.en: independent; to act for oneself; autonomous

ex.zh: 我们应该走出什么样的步伐。
ex.p: wǒ men yīng gāi zǒu chū shén me yàng de bù fá
ex.en: What steps should we take?

ex.zh: 我们真的得加紧步伐了。
ex.p: wǒ men zhēn de de jiā jǐn bù fá le
ex.en: We've really got to step on it.

items.en: hand and foot; movement of limbs; action

ex.zh: 他撞车是因为有人在刹车上做了手脚。
ex.p: tā zhuàng chē shì yīn wèi yǒu rén zài shā chē shǎng zuò le shǒu jiǎo
ex.en: He crashed his car because someone tampered with the brakes.

items.en: to (carry) on one's person; to (take) with one

ex.zh: 不要那么幼稚。
ex.p: bù yào nà me yòu zhì
ex.en: Don't be so childish.

items.en: to smuggle; to have an illicit affair
to defraud; to swindle; to blackmail
to save; to remedy; to rescue
expansion; dilation; to expand (e.g. one's power or influence)

ex.zh: 眼下我不得不和我朋友同住这间房间。
ex.p: yǎn xià wǒ bù dé bù hé wǒ péng you tóng zhù zhè jiān fáng jiān
ex.en: For the time being, I must share this room with my friend.

ex.zh: 他反对种族歧视。
ex.p: tā fǎn duì zhǒng zú qí shì
ex.en: He's opposed to racial discrimination.

items.en: to let off; to let slip by; to let sb get away with sth
moist; glossy; sleek; to moisten; to lubricate; to embellish; to enhance

ex.zh: 旅行社的利润猛涨。
ex.p: lǚ xíng shè de lì rùn měng zhǎng
ex.en: Travel agencies' profits soared.

ex.zh: 润滑系统设计得不好。
ex.p: rùn huá xì tǒng shè jì de bù hǎo
ex.en: The lubrication system was poorly designed.

items.en: inadvertent; accidental; to have no intention of (doing sth)

ex.zh: 没有爱情的生活毫无意义。
ex.p: méi yǒu ài qíng de shēng huó háo wú yì yì
ex.en: Life without love has no meaning at all.

ex.zh: 他说的话根本毫无意义。

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 7–9 · 第142单元

Science and technology

Grammar focus: Popular-science articles, AI and the internet; explaining a process in writing

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 那女士容忍了那男人。
sents.p: nà nǚ shì róng rěn le nà nán rén
sents.en: The lady tolerated the man.

sents.zh: 你能容忍他做事的方式么？
sents.p: nǐ néng róng rěn tā zuò shì de fāng shì me
sents.en: Can you put up with the way he behaves?

sents.zh: 她邀请我们去她的生日派对。
sents.p: tā yāo qǐng wǒ men qù tā de shēng rì pài duì
sents.en: She invited us to her birthday party.

sents.zh: 我邀请他去派对，他接受了。
sents.p: wǒ yāo qǐng tā qù pài duì tā jiē shòu le
sents.en: I invited him to the party and he accepted.

sents.zh: 章鱼小丸子真的很美味！
sents.p: zhāng yú xiǎo wán zǐ zhēn de hěn měi wèi
sents.en: Takoyaki is really quite delicious.

sents.zh: 汤姆是个不寻常的人。
sents.p: tāng mǔ shì gè bù xún cháng de rén
sents.en: Tom is an extraordinary man.

sents.zh: 我们同意了第二天一早开始。
sents.p: wǒ men tóng yì le dì èr tiān yī zǎo kāi shǐ
sents.en: We agreed to start early the next morning.

sents.zh: 他扮演哈姆雷特的角色。
sents.p: tā bàn yǎn hā mǔ léi tè de jué sè
sents.en: He played the part of Hamlet.

sents.zh: 汤姆的上司真的非常生气。
sents.p: tāng mǔ de shàng si zhēn de fēi cháng shēng qì
sents.en: Tom's boss was really angry.

sents.zh: 如果你有上司的话，学会尊敬他（她）。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ yǒu shàng si de huà xué huì zūn jìng tā tā
sents.en: Be respectful to your superiors, if you have any.

sents.zh: 这是我们的荣幸。
sents.p: zhè shì wǒ men de róng xìng
sents.en: It's our pleasure.

sents.zh: 汤姆往他的吐司上放了许多蜂蜜。
sents.p: tāng mǔ wǎng tā de tǔ sī shǎng fàng le xǔ duō fēng mì
sents.en: Tom put a lot of honey on his toast.

sents.zh: 汤姆往他的面包片上放了许多蜂蜜。
sents.p: tāng mǔ wǎng tā de miàn bāo piān shǎng fàng le xǔ duō fēng mì
sents.en: Tom put a lot of honey on his toast.

sents.zh: 汤姆和我不是抱怨的人。
sents.p: tāng mǔ hé wǒ bù shì bào yuàn de rén
sents.en: Tom and I weren't the ones who complained.

sents.zh: 她抱怨我的薪水很低。
sents.p: tā bào yuàn wǒ de xīn shuǐ hěn dī
sents.en: She complained that my salary was low.

sents.zh: 会为你说谎的人，就会对你说谎。
sents.p: huì wèi nǐ shuō huǎng de rén jiù huì duì nǐ shuō huǎng
sents.en: People who will lie for you, will lie to you.

sents.zh: 父母教育他们的孩子说谎是不好的。
sents.p: fù mǔ jiào yù tā men de hái zi shuō huǎng shì bù hǎo de
sents.en: Parents teach their children that it's wrong to lie.

sents.zh: 这让我感到沮丧。
sents.p: zhè ràng wǒ gǎn dào jǔ sàng
sents.en: It makes me feel sad.

sents.zh: 汤姆有点沮丧。
sents.p: tāng mǔ yǒu diǎn jǔ sàng
sents.en: Tom is a little depressed.

sents.zh: 那是唯一的出路。
sents.p: nà shì wéi yī de chū lù
sents.en: It was the only way to go.

sents.zh: 人们说爱情是盲目的。
sents.p: rén men shuō ài qíng shì máng mù de
sents.en: They say love is blind.

sents.zh: 恋爱使人盲目。
sents.p: liàn ài shǐ rén máng mù
sents.en: Love is blind.

sents.zh: 他迟早会回来的。
sents.p: tā chí zǎo huì huí lai de
sents.en: He will come back sooner or later.

sents.zh: 他的急脾气迟早会惹祸上身。
sents.p: tā de jí pí qi chí zǎo huì rě huò shǎng shēn
sents.en: His quick temper will get him in trouble one day.

sents.zh: 没人解得了这个谜题。
sents.p: méi rén xiè dé le zhè gè mèi tí
sents.en: No one could solve the puzzle.

sents.zh: 你解开谜团了吗？
sents.p: nǐ jiě kāi mí tuán le ma
sents.en: Have you worked the puzzle out?

sents.zh: 我们有充裕的时间赶上火车。
sents.p: wǒ men yǒu chōng yù de shí jiān gǎn shàng huǒ chē
sents.en: We have ample time to catch our train.

sents.zh: 你的理由很充分。
sents.p: nǐ de lǐ yóu hěn chōng fèn
sents.en: Your reason is very good.

sents.zh: 在这个城市，白人和黑人间的争端愈演愈烈。
sents.p: zài zhè gè chéng shì bái rén hé hēi rén jiān de zhēng duān yù yǎn yù liè
sents.en: The conflict between blacks and whites in the city became worse.

sents.zh: 你是不是瞒着我什么？
sents.p: nǐ shì bù shì mán zhe wǒ shén me
sents.en: Are you hiding something?

sents.zh: 我常常能分辨出来一个人是不是瞒着我什么事情。
sents.p: wǒ cháng cháng néng fēn biàn chū lái yī gè rén shì bù shì mán zhe wǒ shén me shì qing
sents.en: I can usually tell when someone is hiding something from me.

sents.zh: 我们应该走出什么样的步伐。
sents.p: wǒ men yīng gāi zǒu chū shén me yàng de bù fá
sents.en: What steps should we take?

sents.zh: 我们真的得加紧步伐了。
sents.p: wǒ men zhēn de de jiā jǐn bù fá le
sents.en: We've really got to step on it.

sents.zh: 他撞车是因为有人在刹车上做了手脚。
sents.p: tā zhuàng chē shì yīn wèi yǒu rén zài shā chē shǎng zuò le shǒu jiǎo
sents.en: He crashed his car because someone tampered with the brakes.

sents.zh: 不要那么幼稚。
sents.p: bù yào nà me yòu zhì
sents.en: Don't be so childish.

sents.zh: 眼下我不得不和我朋友同住这间房间。
sents.p: yǎn xià wǒ bù dé bù hé wǒ péng you tóng zhù zhè jiān fáng jiān
sents.en: For the time being, I must share this room with my friend.

sents.zh: 他反对种族歧视。
sents.p: tā fǎn duì zhǒng zú qí shì
sents.en: He's opposed to racial discrimination.

sents.zh: 旅行社的利润猛涨。
sents.p: lǚ xíng shè de lì rùn měng zhǎng
sents.en: Travel agencies' profits soared.

sents.zh: 润滑系统设计得不好。
sents.p: rùn huá xì tǒng shè jì de bù hǎo
sents.en: The lubrication system was poorly designed.

sents.zh: 没有爱情的生活毫无意义。
sents.p: méi yǒu ài qíng de shēng huó háo wú yì yì
sents.en: Life without love has no meaning at all.

sents.zh: 他说的话根本毫无意义。
sents.p: tā shuō de huà gēn běn háo wú yì yì
sents.en: What he says is total nonsense.

sents.zh: 今天我头痛欲裂。
sents.p: jīn tiān wǒ tóu tòng yù liè
sents.en: I have a bad headache today.

sents.zh: 我的嘴裂开了。
sents.p: wǒ de zuǐ liè kāi le
sents.en: I have chapped lips.

sents.zh: 如果你没好话说，那就什么都别说。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ méi hǎo huà shuō nà jiù shén me dōu bié shuō
sents.en: If you don't have anything nice to say, don't say anything at all.

sents.zh: 请勿触碰展品。
sents.p: qǐng wù chù pèng zhǎn pǐn
sents.en: Don't touch the exhibits.

sents.zh: 汤姆不知道拿他车库的那些废物怎么办。
sents.p: tāng mǔ bù zhī dào ná tā chē kù de nà xiē fèi wù zěn me bàn
sents.en: Tom has no idea what to do with all the junk in his garage.

sents.zh: 我喜欢视野好的房子。
sents.p: wǒ xǐ huan shì yě hǎo de fáng zi
sents.en: I'd like a room with a good view.

sents.zh: 委员会一个月召开两次。
sents.p: wěi yuán huì yī gè yuè zhào kāi liǎng cì
sents.en: The committee meets twice a month.

sents.zh: 议员受到了议会道德委员会的谴责。
sents.p: yì yuán shòu dào le yì huì dào dé wěi yuán huì de qiǎn zé

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 7–9 · 第143单元

Science and technology

Grammar focus: Popular-science articles, AI and the internet; explaining a process in writing

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 警方逮捕了嫌疑人。
sents.p: jǐng fāng dài bǔ le xián yí rén
sents.en: The police arrested the suspect.

sents.zh: 嫌疑人是一位白人女性。
sents.p: xián yí rén shì yī wèi bái rén nǚ xìng
sents.en: The suspect is a caucasian female.

sents.zh: 我听传闻说的。
sents.p: wǒ yǐn chuán wén shuō de
sents.en: A little bird told me.

sents.zh: 汤姆说的预言全部都应验了。
sents.p: tāng mǔ shuō de yù yán quán bù dōu yīng yàn le
sents.en: All of Tom's predictions came true.

sents.zh: 你的预言成真了。
sents.p: nǐ de yù yán chéng zhēn le
sents.en: Your prophecy has come true.

sents.zh: 事情要失控了。
sents.p: shì qing yào shī kòng le
sents.en: Things are getting out of control.

sents.zh: 我强烈反对妥协
sents.p: wǒ qiáng liè fǎn duì tuǒ xié
sents.en: I'm strongly opposed to a compromise.

sents.zh: 他们惊得目瞪口呆。
sents.p: tā men jīng de mù dèng kǒu dāi
sents.en: They were left speechless.

sents.zh: 汤姆在车流中来回穿行。
sents.p: tāng mǔ zài chē liú zhōng lái huí chuān xíng
sents.en: Tom zigzagged between the cars.

sents.zh: 议员受到了议会道德委员会的谴责。
sents.p: yì yuán shòu dào le yì huì dào dé wěi yuán huì de qiǎn zé
sents.en: The senator was censured by the congressional ethics committee.

sents.zh: 是在这点上我们的意见有分歧。
sents.p: shì zài zhè diǎn shǎng wǒ men de yì jiàn yǒu fēn qí
sents.en: It's on this point that our opinions differ.

sents.zh: 昨晚，烟花厂发生了爆炸。
sents.p: zuó wǎn yān huā hǎn fā shēng le bào zhà
sents.en: Yesterday, an explosion occurred at the fireworks factory.

sents.zh: 那些海报现在都到哪里去了？
sents.p: nà xiē hǎi bào xiàn zài dōu dào nǎ lǐ qù le
sents.en: Where are those posters now?

sents.zh: 我叫她不要松开绳子，但是她做了。
sents.p: wǒ jiào tā bù yào sōng kāi shéng zi dàn shì tā zuò le
sents.en: I told her not to let go of the rope, but she did.

sents.zh: 绳子不够牢固，撑不住他。
sents.p: shéng zi bù gòu láo gù chēng bù zhù tā
sents.en: The rope wasn't strong enough to support him.

sents.zh: 你生日的时候，我送你一辆自行车。
sents.p: nǐ shēng rì de shí hou wǒ sòng nǐ yī liàng zì xíng chē
sents.en: I will get you a bike for your birthday.

sents.zh: 你还没有为我的自行车付完款吗？
sents.p: nǐ hái méi yǒu wèi wǒ de zì xíng chē fù wán kuǎn ma
sents.en: Have you still not finished paying for my bike?

sents.zh: 警方拘留了他。
sents.p: jǐng fāng jū liú le tā
sents.en: The police held him in custody.

sents.zh: 汤姆说话的法国腔很重。
sents.p: tāng mǔ shuō huà de fǎ guó qiāng hěn zhòng
sents.en: Tom has a very strong French accent.

sents.zh: 你对复合碳水化合物有什么了解吗？
sents.p: nǐ duì fù hé tàn shuǐ huā gě wù yǒu shén me liǎo jiě ma
sents.en: Do you know anything about complex carbohydrates?

sents.zh: 你知道什么是复合词吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhī dào shén me shì fù hé cí ma
sents.en: Do you know what compound words are?

sents.zh: 气象学家说会有暴风雨。
sents.p: qì xiàng xué jiā shuō huì yǒu bào fēng yǔ
sents.en: The weatherman says there is a storm on the way.

sents.zh: 我不能忍受他的傲慢。
sents.p: wǒ bù néng rěn shòu tā de ào màn
sents.en: I can't stand his arrogance.

sents.zh: 汤姆现在会以我为傲。
sents.p: tāng mǔ xiàn zài huì yǐ wǒ wèi ào
sents.en: Tom will now be proud of me.

sents.zh: 我不介意你在我回到家之前先去睡觉。
sents.p: wǒ bù jiè yì nǐ zài wǒ huí dào jiā zhī qián xiān qù shuì jiào
sents.en: I don't mind if you go to bed before I get home.

sents.p: nín jiè bù jiè yì wǒ bǎ dēng guān le
sents.en: Do you mind if I turn off the light?

sents.zh: 和她争辩是没用的。
sents.p: hé tā zhēng biàn shì méi yòng de
sents.en: It is no use arguing with her.

sents.zh: 汤姆不认为这是一个巧合。
sents.p: tāng mǔ bù rèn wéi zhè shì yī gè qiǎo hé
sents.en: Tom doesn't think this is a coincidence.

sents.zh: 也许这只是一场巧合。
sents.p: yě xǔ zhè zhǐ shì yī cháng qiǎo hé
sents.en: Maybe it was just a coincidence.

sents.zh: 他的性情古怪。
sents.p: tā de xìng qíng gǔ guài
sents.en: He's a strange character.

sents.zh: 他的头撞倒了一块岩石。
sents.p: tā de tóu zhuàng dào le yī kuài yán shí
sents.en: He hit his head against a rock.

sents.zh: 一块岩石从上面落下。
sents.p: yī kuài yán shí cóng shàng miàn luò xià
sents.en: A rock fell from above.

sents.zh: 墨汁用作染料时会产生有趣的图案。
sents.p: mò zhī yòng zuō rǎn liào shí huì chǎn shēng yǒu qù de tú àn
sents.en: India ink produces an interesting pattern when used as a dye.

sents.zh: 她被要求用墨水写下她的名字。
sents.p: tā bèi yāo qiú yòng mò shuǐ xiě xià tā de míng zi
sents.en: She was asked to write her name in ink.

sents.zh: 我们全力以赴来完成工作。
sents.p: wǒ men quán lì yǐ fù lái wán chéng gōng zuò
sents.en: We went all out to get the job done.

sents.zh: 我朋友邀我共赴晚餐。
sents.p: wǒ péng you yāo wǒ gòng fù wǎn cān
sents.en: My friends invited me to dinner.

sents.zh: 我是足球的忠实粉丝。
sents.p: wǒ shì zú qiú de zhōng shí fěn sī
sents.en: I'm a big football fan.

sents.zh: 会议已经被延迟到明天了。
sents.p: huì yì yǐ jīng bèi yán chí dào míng tiān le

sents.p: yóu yú tiān qì biàn chà chū fā yán chí le

sents.zh: 缓期执行在最后关头决定了下来。
sents.p: huǎn qī zhí xíng zài zuì hòu guān tóu jué dìng le xià lai

sents.p: bù yào nu:è dài dòng wù
sents.en: Don't be cruel to animals.

sents.p: qù nián xià tiān wǒ men zài qiáo shǎng kàn yàn huǒ kàn de hěn guò yǐn
sents.en: We enjoyed watching the fireworks on a bridge last summer.

sents.p: tāng mǔ xiǎng bǎ fáng zi qī chéng lǜ sè shì zhēn de ma

sents.zh: 我告诉汤姆我认为他的房子要刷漆。
sents.p: wǒ gào sù tāng mǔ wǒ rèn wéi tā de fáng zi yào shuā qī

sents.p: tā de yá chǐ bèi yān xūn huáng le
sents.en: His teeth are yellow from smoking too much.

sents.p: tāng mǔ bù shì zhǒng zú zhǔ yì zhě

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 7–9 · 第144单元

Science and technology

Grammar focus: Popular-science articles, AI and the internet; explaining a process in writing

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 她母亲将继续工作。
sents.p: tā mǔ qīn jiāng jì xù gōng zuò
sents.en: Her mother will continue to work.

sents.zh: 请继续讲你的故事。
sents.p: qǐng jì xù jiǎng nǐ de gù shì
sents.en: Please go on with your story.

sents.zh: 女士们身着晚礼服。
sents.p: nǚ shì men shēn zhe wǎn lǐ fú
sents.en: The ladies were in evening dress.

sents.zh: 亲吻一个抽烟的人就像在舔烟灰缸。
sents.p: qīn wěn yī gè chōu yān de rén jiù xiàng zài tiǎn yān huī gāng
sents.en: Kissing a smoker is like licking an ashtray.

sents.zh: 她把毛巾折叠好再放入柜子里。
sents.p: tā bǎ máo jīn zhé dié hǎo zài fàng rù guì zi lǐ
sents.en: She folded up the towels and put them away in the cupboard.

sents.zh: 我在叠我的连衣裙。
sents.p: wǒ zài dié wǒ de lián yī qún
sents.en: I'm folding my dress.

sents.zh: 整个过程需要耗费数月。
sents.p: zhěng gè guò chéng xū yào hào fèi shù yuè
sents.en: The whole process will take months.

sents.zh: 我的力气耗尽了。
sents.p: wǒ de lì qi hào jǐn le
sents.en: My strength is all gone.

sents.zh: 汤姆不习惯光着脚漫步。
sents.p: tāng mǔ bù xí guàn guāng zhe jiǎo màn bù
sents.en: Tom isn't used to walking barefooted.

sents.zh: 我不介意在雨中漫步。
sents.p: wǒ bù jiè yì zài yǔ zhōng màn bù
sents.en: I don't mind walking in the rain.

sents.zh: 日本有很多温泉。
sents.p: rì běn yǒu hěn duō wēn quán
sents.en: There are a lot of hot springs in Japan.

sents.zh: 洪水涌到了窗户的高度。
sents.p: hóng shuǐ chōng dào le chuāng hu de gāo dù
sents.en: The flood water reached the level of the windows.

sents.zh: 剧场里涌出一大群人。
sents.p: jù chǎng lǐ chōng chū yī dà qún rén
sents.en: A stream of people came out of the theater.

sents.zh: 这是奇妙的体验。
sents.p: zhè shì qí miào de tǐ yàn
sents.en: It's been an amazing experience.

sents.zh: 他有着奇妙的想法。
sents.p: tā yǒu zhe qí miào de xiǎng fǎ
sents.en: He has strange ideas.

sents.zh: 我拒绝被你像奴隶一样对待。
sents.p: wǒ jù jué bèi nǐ xiàng nú lì yī yàng duì dài
sents.en: I refuse to be treated like a slave by you.

sents.zh: 汤姆已经因病卧床三周了。
sents.p: tāng mǔ yǐ jīng yīn bìng wò chuáng sān zhōu le
sents.en: Tom has been sick in bed for three weeks.

sents.zh: 他已卧病在床四天了。
sents.p: tā yǐ wò bìng zài chuáng sì tiān le
sents.en: He's been sick in bed for four days.

sents.zh: 汤姆是个无知的傻子。
sents.p: tāng mǔ shì gè wú zhī de shǎ zǐ
sents.en: Tom is an ignorant fool.

sents.zh: 要想成功只需要无知和自信。
sents.p: yào xiǎng chéng gōng zhǐ xū yào wú zhī hé zì xìn
sents.en: All you need is ignorance and confidence and the success is sure.

sents.zh: 指南针的指针指向北边。
sents.p: zhǐ nán zhēn de zhǐ zhēn zhǐ xiàng běi biān
sents.en: Compass needles point to the north.

sents.zh: 指南针指向北边。
sents.p: zhǐ nán zhēn zhǐ xiàng běi biān
sents.en: The compass points to the north.

sents.zh: 我们能私下谈谈吗？
sents.p: wǒ men néng sī xià tán tán ma
sents.en: Can we talk in private?

sents.zh: 我能跟你私下谈一分钟吗？
sents.p: wǒ néng gēn nǐ sī xià tán yī fēn zhōng ma
sents.en: Can I talk to you privately for a minute?

sents.zh: 我们要达成一些协定。
sents.p: wǒ men yào dá chéng yī xiē xié dìng
sents.en: We have to come to some agreement.

sents.zh: 他的画被悬挂在墙上。
sents.p: tā de huà bèi xuán guà zài qiáng shǎng
sents.en: His pictures were hung on the wall.

sents.zh: 车子若是掉落悬崖他们早就没命了。
sents.p: chē zǐ ruò shì diào là xuán yá tā men zǎo jiù méi mìng le
sents.en: They'd have been killed if the car had gone over the cliff.

sents.zh: 她有一颗纯洁的心。
sents.p: tā yǒu yī kē chún jié de xīn
sents.en: She has a pure heart.

sents.zh: 汤姆享受园艺。
sents.p: tāng mǔ xiǎng shòu yuán yì
sents.en: Tom enjoys gardening.

sents.zh: 今晚我非常享受和你的聊天。
sents.p: jīn wǎn wǒ fēi cháng xiǎng shòu hé nǐ de liáo tiān
sents.en: I enjoyed talking with you this evening very much.

sents.zh: 汤姆拧干毛巾挂起来晾干。
sents.p: tāng mǔ níng gàn máo jīn guà qǐ lai liàng gàn
sents.en: Tom wrung out the towel and hung it up to dry.

sents.zh: 她把我的玩笑当真了。
sents.p: tā bǎ wǒ de wán xiào dàng zhēn le
sents.en: She took my joke seriously.

sents.zh: 我们要设法跟他们交流。
sents.p: wǒ men yào shè fǎ gēn tā men jiāo liú
sents.en: We have to try to communicate with them.

sents.zh: 她想方设法以一己之力完成了工作。
sents.p: tā xiǎng fāng shè fǎ yǐ yī jǐ zhī lì wán chéng le gōng zuò
sents.en: She managed to finish the work on her own.

sents.zh: 他刮下靴子上的泥巴。
sents.p: tā guā xià xuē zi shǎng de ní ba
sents.en: He scraped the mud off his boots.

sents.zh: 我需要我的靴子。
sents.p: wǒ xū yào wǒ de xuē zi
sents.en: I need my boots.

sents.zh: 死是唯一的解脱吗？
sents.p: sǐ shì wéi yī de jiě tuō ma
sents.en: Is death the only way out?

sents.zh: 人们需要止住仇恨。
sents.p: rén men xū yào zhǐ zhù chóu hèn
sents.en: People need to stop hating.

sents.zh: 我这个月要减少开支。
sents.p: wǒ zhè gè yuè yào jiǎn shǎo kāi zhī
sents.en: I have to reduce my expenses this month.

lessons.title: 本课 · Theme and grammar
lessons.html:
HSK 7–9 · 第145单元

Science and technology

Grammar focus: Popular-science articles, AI and the internet; explaining a process in writing

Learn the pattern with the words in this unit; the example sentences use only characters you have met so far wherever possible.

sents.zh: 汤姆把他想去的地方列成了一张清单。
sents.p: tāng mǔ bǎ tā xiǎng qù de dì fāng liè chéng le yī zhāng qīng dān
sents.en: Tom made a list of places he wants to visit.

sents.zh: 完全忽视汤姆不会是明智的。
sents.p: wán quán hū shì tāng mǔ bù huì shì míng zhì de
sents.en: It wouldn't be wise to ignore Tom completely.

sents.zh: 他的忠告总是很明智。
sents.p: tā de zhōng gào zǒng shì hěn míng zhì
sents.en: His advice is always very sensible.

sents.zh: 我在报纸上刊登了我的房子的广告。
sents.p: wǒ zài bào zhǐ shǎng kān dēng le wǒ de fáng zi de guǎng gào
sents.en: I advertised my house in the newspaper.

sents.zh: 不要让这些信息泄露出去。
sents.p: bù yào ràng zhè xiē xìn xī xiè lù chū qù
sents.en: Don't let this information leak out.

sents.zh: 我对你的厚颜无耻感到惊讶。
sents.p: wǒ duì nǐ de hòu yán wú chǐ gǎn dào jīng yà
sents.en: I'm amazed at your audacity.

sents.zh: 我本来预备今天去海滩的，但接着天就开始下雨了。
sents.p: wǒ běn lái yù bèi jīn tiān qù hǎi tān de dàn jiē zhe tiān jiù kāi shǐ xià yǔ le
sents.en: I was planning on going to the beach today, but then it started to rain.

sents.zh: 我一天又一天地给她写信。
sents.p: wǒ yī tiān yòu yī tiān dì gěi tā xiě xìn
sents.en: I wrote her a letter every day.

sents.zh: 我厌倦了他的老笑话。
sents.p: wǒ yàn juàn le tā de lǎo xiào hua
sents.en: I was bored with his old jokes.

sents.zh: 我厌倦了我的工作。
sents.p: wǒ yàn juàn le wǒ de gōng zuò
sents.en: I am tired of my work.

sents.zh: 公主向皇帝请求饶恕。
sents.p: gōng zhǔ xiàng huáng dì qǐng qiú ráo shù
sents.en: The princess begged forgiveness from the emperor.

sents.zh: 尽管有金钱和名誉，他还是不幸福。
sents.p: jǐn guǎn yǒu jīn qián hé míng yù tā hái shi bù xìng fú
sents.en: Even with all his wealth and fame, he's unhappy.

sents.zh: 她把头垂在她母亲的肩上。
sents.p: tā bǎ tóu chuí zài tā mǔ qīn de jiān shǎng
sents.en: She rested her head on her mother's shoulder.

sents.zh: 我好奇耳垂有什么作用。
sents.p: wǒ hào qí ěr chuí yǒu shén me zuò yòng
sents.en: I wonder what ear lobes are for.

sents.zh: 汤姆是一个越军退役军人。
sents.p: tāng mǔ shì yī gè yuè jūn tuì yì jūn rén
sents.en: Tom is a Vietnam veteran.

sents.zh: 汤姆握紧了他的拳头。
sents.p: tāng mǔ wò jǐn le tā de quán tou
sents.en: Tom clenched his fists.

sents.zh: 它是基本人权。
sents.p: tā shì jī běn rén quán
sents.en: It's a basic human right.

sents.zh: 我们必须查明汤姆在哪里。
sents.p: wǒ men bì xū chá míng tāng mǔ zài nǎ lǐ
sents.en: We have to find out where Tom is.

sents.zh: 给我们弹一手。
sents.p: gěi wǒ men dàn yī shǒu
sents.en: Play us a tune.

sents.zh: 我爸爸能做一手好菜，我很自豪。
sents.p: wǒ bà ba néng zuò yī shǒu hǎo cài wǒ hěn zì háo
sents.en: I'm proud that my father is a good cook.

sents.zh: 汤姆吹灭了蛋糕上的所有蜡烛。
sents.p: tāng mǔ chuī miè le dàn gāo shǎng de suǒ yǒu là zhú
sents.en: Tom blew out all the candles on the cake.

sents.zh: 数以千计的蜡烛点亮了仪式中的教堂。
sents.p: shù yǐ qiān jì de là zhú diǎn liàng le yí shì zhōng de jiào táng
sents.en: Thousands of candles illuminated the church during the ceremony.

sents.zh: 我把盒子扛在肩上。
sents.p: wǒ bǎ hé zi gāng zài jiān shǎng
sents.en: I carried the box on my shoulder.

sents.zh: 我认为汤姆一点教学经验都没有。
sents.p: wǒ rèn wéi tāng mǔ yī diǎn jiāo xué jīng yàn dōu méi yǒu
sents.en: I don't think Tom has any teaching experience.

sents.zh: 汤姆不是一个经验老道的司机。
sents.p: tāng mǔ bù shì yī gè jīng yàn lǎo dào de sī jī
sents.en: Tom isn't an experienced driver.

sents.zh: 他们中的一些人身体健康，但是其他人不是。
sents.p: tā men zhōng de yī xiē rén shēn tǐ jiàn kāng dàn shì qí tā rén bù shì
sents.en: Some of them are healthy, but others are not.

sents.zh: 他的家不幸有人身亡。
sents.p: tā de jiā bù xìng yǒu rén shēn wáng
sents.en: There's been a death in his family.

sents.zh: 我面对陌生人很不自在。
sents.p: wǒ miàn duì mò shēng rén hěn bù zì zai
sents.en: I am very ill at ease with strangers.

sents.zh: 我知道你不自在，但别急。
sents.p: wǒ zhī dào nǐ bù zì zai dàn bié jí
sents.en: I understand that you feel uneasy, but don't worry.

sents.zh: 这个寺庙是何时造的？
sents.p: zhè gè sì miào shì hé shí zào de
sents.en: When was this temple built?

sents.zh: 摧毁这个寺庙。
sents.p: cuī huǐ zhè gè sì miào
sents.en: Destroy this temple.

sents.zh: 学校会提供帐篷给我们。
sents.p: xué xiào huì tí gōng zhàng peng gěi wǒ men
sents.en: The school will provide tents for us.

sents.zh: 这是搭帐篷的好地方。
sents.p: zhè shì dā zhàng peng de hǎo dì fāng
sents.en: This is a good place to pitch a tent.

sents.zh: 音乐的重要性被低估了。
sents.p: yīn yuè de zhòng yào xìng bèi dī gū le
sents.en: The importance of music is underrated.

sents.zh: 千万不可低估汤姆。
sents.p: qiān wàn bù kě dī gū tāng mǔ
sents.en: Never underestimate Tom.

sents.zh: 汤姆检查电视时间表，看看在上映什么。
sents.p: tāng mǔ jiǎn chá diàn shì shí jiān biǎo kàn kàn zài shàng yìng shén me
sents.en: Tom checked the TV schedule to see what was on.

sents.zh: 汤姆搜查了衣柜里面。
sents.p: tāng mǔ sōu chá le yī guì lǐ miàn
sents.en: Tom searched inside the closet.

sents.zh: 罢工妨碍了国家经济。
sents.p: bà gōng fáng ài le guó jiā jīng jì
sents.en: The strike affected the nation's economy.

sents.zh: 罢工影响了国家经济。
sents.p: bà gōng yǐng xiǎng le guó jiā jīng jì
sents.en: The strike affected the nation's economy.

sents.zh: 水沸腾后变为蒸汽。
sents.p: shuǐ fèi téng hòu biàn wéi zhēng qì
sents.en: Water steams when it boils.

sents.zh: 你不要自甘堕落。
sents.p: nǐ bù yào zì gān duò luò
sents.en: You don't have to kick yourself.

sents.zh: 迄今，一切妥当。
sents.p: qì jīn yī qiè tuǒ dang
sents.en: So far, so good.

units.intro: Grammar focus: Popular-science articles, AI and the internet; explaining a process in writing

items.en: to resolve; to decompose; to break down

ex.zh: 我是你的代理人。
ex.p: wǒ shì nǐ de dài lǐ rén
ex.en: I'm your deputy.

ex.zh: 我赌上我的名声。
ex.p: wǒ dǔ shǎng wǒ de míng shēng
ex.en: I'll stake my reputation on it.

ex.zh: 把椅子挪一挪靠近桌子。
ex.p: bǎ yǐ zi nuó yī nuó kào jìn zhuō zi
ex.en: Move the chair nearer to the desk.

ex.zh: 丑闻让他付出了失去声誉的代价。
ex.p: chǒu wén ràng tā fù chū le shī qù shēng yù de dài jià
ex.en: That scandal cost him his reputation.

items.en: to unload; to unhitch; to remove or strip
down to; up to; to the extent that...

ex.zh: 汤姆太专注于他的工作，以至于忘了吃饭。
ex.p: tāng mǔ tài zhuān zhù yú tā de gōng zuò yǐ zhì yú wàng le chī fàn
ex.en: Tom got so absorbed in his work that he forgot to eat.

ex.zh: 土豆太热，以至于烫到了我的嘴。
ex.p: tǔ dòu tài rè yǐ zhì yú tàng dào le wǒ de zuǐ
ex.en: The potato was so hot that it burned my mouth.

items.en: to melt; to thaw; to blend

ex.zh: 如果你加热冰它就会融化。
ex.p: rú guǒ nǐ jiā rè bīng tā jiù huì róng huà
ex.en: If you heat ice, it melts.

ex.zh: 太阳一出来，雪就会融化。
ex.p: tài yang yī chū lái xuě jiù huì róng huà
ex.en: The snow will melt when the sun comes out.

ex.zh: 让我们来澄清一下这个问题。
ex.p: ràng wǒ men lái chéng qīng yī xià zhè gè wèn tí
ex.en: Let's clear up this problem.

ex.zh: 我们像澄清这个问题
ex.p: wǒ men xiàng chéng qīng zhè gè wèn tí
ex.en: We want to clear up this problem.

items.en: at worst; if worst comes to worst; (usu. in the negative) serious; alarming

ex.zh: 这没什么大不了的。
ex.p: zhè méi shén me dà bù liǎo de
ex.en: It's no big deal.

ex.zh: 那没什么大不了的。
ex.p: nà méi shén me dà bù liǎo de
ex.en: That's no big deal.

ex.zh: 不是所有外星人都坏。
ex.p: bù shì suǒ yǒu wài xīng rén dōu huài
ex.en: Not all aliens are bad.

ex.zh: 你觉着有外星人存在吗？
ex.p: nǐ jué zhe yǒu wài xīng rén cún zài ma
ex.en: Do you think there are aliens?

items.en: to bear; to give birth; to grow
(of a liquid or gas) to leak; to divulge; to leak (information)
to hack; to chop; to split open
soon; at an early date; the early days; the past
to utilize; to put sth to use
to crush; to smash; to shatter

ex.zh: 我觉得汤姆对我们撒谎了。
ex.p: wǒ jué de tāng mǔ duì wǒ men sā huǎng le
ex.en: I think Tom lied to us.

ex.zh: 汤姆有可能对你撒谎了。
ex.p: tāng mǔ yǒu kě néng duì nǐ sā huǎng le
ex.en: It's possible that Tom lied to you.

ex.zh: 患者现在处于深度昏迷状态。
ex.p: huàn zhě xiàn zài chǔ yú shēn dù hūn mí zhuàng tài
ex.en: The patient is in a deep coma.

ex.zh: 汤姆正昏迷不醒。
ex.p: tāng mǔ zhēng hūn mí bù xǐng
ex.en: Tom's out cold.

ex.zh: 我妻子想收养一个孩子。
ex.p: wǒ qī zǐ xiǎng shōu yǎng yī gè hái zi
ex.en: My wife wants to adopt a child.

ex.zh: 我们收养了一个孩子。
ex.p: wǒ men shōu yǎng le yī gè hái zi
ex.en: We adopted a child.

items.en: to lift; to raise (a lid etc); (of a storm) to surge; to stir up (waves etc)

ex.zh: 汤姆挺固执的不是吗？
ex.p: tāng mǔ tǐng gù zhí de bù shì ma
ex.en: Tom is being quite obstinate, isn't he?

items.en: to wash; to clean out; to cleanse
for a time; at one time; one time
to sense; to perceive; to become aware of
radish (Raphanus sativus), esp. white radish 白萝卜

ex.zh: 把胡萝卜放在锅里。
ex.p: bǎ hú luó bo fàng zài guō lǐ
ex.en: Put the carrots in the pot.

ex.zh: 汤姆不喜欢胡萝卜。
ex.p: tāng mǔ bù xǐ huan hú luó bo
ex.en: Tom doesn't like carrots.

items.en: (lit. and fig.) to permeate; to seep into; (of hostile forces) to infiltrate
to collapse; to droop; to settle down

ex.zh: 她讲话非常俗气。
ex.p: tā jiǎng huà fēi cháng sú qì
ex.en: She is extremely vulgar in her speech.

ex.zh: 海龟是爬行动物。
ex.p: hǎi guī shì pá xíng dòng wù
ex.en: Turtles are reptiles.

items.en: a resolution; to pass a resolution

ex.zh: 那时我没有选择的余地。
ex.p: nà shí wǒ méi yǒu xuǎn zé de yú dì
ex.en: I had no choice.

ex.zh: 我的业余爱好是拍野花的照片。
ex.p: wǒ de yè yú ài hào shì pāi yě huā de zhào piàn
ex.en: My hobby is taking pictures of wild flowers.

items.en: to settle (a dispute out of court); to reconcile; settlement

ex.zh: 现在握个手和解吧。
ex.p: xiàn zài wò gè shǒu hé jiě ba
ex.en: Now shake hands and make up.

items.en: to decorate; to adorn; to dress up

ex.zh: 我今天早晨感觉良好。
ex.p: wǒ jīn tiān zǎo chén gǎn jué liáng hǎo
ex.en: I'm feeling good this morning.

ex.zh: 我今晚感觉良好。
ex.p: wǒ jīn wǎn gǎn jué liáng hǎo
ex.en: I felt good tonight.

items.en: to reject; to exclude; to eliminate

ex.zh: 他的长相与年龄不符。
ex.p: tā de zhǎng xiàng yú nián líng bù fú
ex.en: He doesn't look his age.

items.en: to pull back; to shrink; to contract
to foster; to bring up; to raise

ex.zh: 我知道金钱不是万能的。
ex.p: wǒ zhī dào jīn qián bù shì wàn néng de
ex.en: I know that money isn't everything.

items.en: to love; to pamper; to spoil

ex.zh: 合理地喂狗可以延长宠物寿命。
ex.p: hé lǐ de wéi gǒu kě yǐ yán cháng chǒng wù shòu mìng
ex.en: If you feed your dog properly, you can increase his lifespan.

items.en: to pit oneself against sb; to compete with sb; contest

ex.zh: 他的缺席导致了各种谣言的产生。
ex.p: tā de quē xí dǎo zhì le gè zhǒng yáo yán de chǎn shēng
ex.en: His absence gave birth to all sorts of rumors.

ex.zh: 我听到了一个很有意思的谣言。
ex.p: wǒ tīng dào le yī gè hěn yǒu yì si de yáo yán
ex.en: I heard a very interesting rumor.

items.en: (followed by a verb phrase, then – optionally – 不可, or 不行 etc) must

sents.zh: 土豆太热，以至于烫到了我的嘴。
sents.p: tǔ dòu tài rè yǐ zhì yú tàng dào le wǒ de zuǐ
sents.en: The potato was so hot that it burned my mouth.

sents.zh: 如果你加热冰它就会融化。
sents.p: rú guǒ nǐ jiā rè bīng tā jiù huì róng huà
sents.en: If you heat ice, it melts.

sents.zh: 太阳一出来，雪就会融化。
sents.p: tài yang yī chū lái xuě jiù huì róng huà
sents.en: The snow will melt when the sun comes out.

sents.zh: 让我们来澄清一下这个问题。
sents.p: ràng wǒ men lái chéng qīng yī xià zhè gè wèn tí
sents.en: Let's clear up this problem.

sents.zh: 我们像澄清这个问题
sents.p: wǒ men xiàng chéng qīng zhè gè wèn tí
sents.en: We want to clear up this problem.

sents.zh: 这没什么大不了的。
sents.p: zhè méi shén me dà bù liǎo de
sents.en: It's no big deal.

sents.zh: 那没什么大不了的。
sents.p: nà méi shén me dà bù liǎo de
sents.en: That's no big deal.

sents.zh: 不是所有外星人都坏。
sents.p: bù shì suǒ yǒu wài xīng rén dōu huài
sents.en: Not all aliens are bad.

sents.zh: 你觉着有外星人存在吗？
sents.p: nǐ jué zhe yǒu wài xīng rén cún zài ma
sents.en: Do you think there are aliens?

sents.zh: 我觉得汤姆对我们撒谎了。
sents.p: wǒ jué de tāng mǔ duì wǒ men sā huǎng le
sents.en: I think Tom lied to us.

sents.zh: 汤姆有可能对你撒谎了。
sents.p: tāng mǔ yǒu kě néng duì nǐ sā huǎng le
sents.en: It's possible that Tom lied to you.

sents.zh: 患者现在处于深度昏迷状态。
sents.p: huàn zhě xiàn zài chǔ yú shēn dù hūn mí zhuàng tài
sents.en: The patient is in a deep coma.

sents.zh: 汤姆正昏迷不醒。
sents.p: tāng mǔ zhēng hūn mí bù xǐng
sents.en: Tom's out cold.

sents.zh: 我妻子想收养一个孩子。
sents.p: wǒ qī zǐ xiǎng shōu yǎng yī gè hái zi
sents.en: My wife wants to adopt a child.

sents.zh: 我们收养了一个孩子。
sents.p: wǒ men shōu yǎng le yī gè hái zi
sents.en: We adopted a child.

sents.zh: 汤姆挺固执的不是吗？
sents.p: tāng mǔ tǐng gù zhí de bù shì ma
sents.en: Tom is being quite obstinate, isn't he?

sents.zh: 把胡萝卜放在锅里。
sents.p: bǎ hú luó bo fàng zài guō lǐ
sents.en: Put the carrots in the pot.

sents.zh: 汤姆不喜欢胡萝卜。
sents.p: tāng mǔ bù xǐ huan hú luó bo
sents.en: Tom doesn't like carrots.

sents.zh: 她讲话非常俗气。
sents.p: tā jiǎng huà fēi cháng sú qì
sents.en: She is extremely vulgar in her speech.

sents.zh: 海龟是爬行动物。
sents.p: hǎi guī shì pá xíng dòng wù
sents.en: Turtles are reptiles.

sents.zh: 那时我没有选择的余地。
sents.p: nà shí wǒ méi yǒu xuǎn zé de yú dì
sents.en: I had no choice.

sents.zh: 我的业余爱好是拍野花的照片。
sents.p: wǒ de yè yú ài hào shì pāi yě huā de zhào piàn
sents.en: My hobby is taking pictures of wild flowers.

sents.zh: 现在握个手和解吧。
sents.p: xiàn zài wò gè shǒu hé jiě ba
sents.en: Now shake hands and make up.

sents.zh: 我今天早晨感觉良好。
sents.p: wǒ jīn tiān zǎo chén gǎn jué liáng hǎo
sents.en: I'm feeling good this morning.

sents.zh: 我今晚感觉良好。
sents.p: wǒ jīn wǎn gǎn jué liáng hǎo
sents.en: I felt good tonight.

sents.zh: 他的长相与年龄不符。
sents.p: tā de zhǎng xiàng yú nián líng bù fú
sents.en: He doesn't look his age.

sents.zh: 我知道金钱不是万能的。
sents.p: wǒ zhī dào jīn qián bù shì wàn néng de
sents.en: I know that money isn't everything.

sents.zh: 合理地喂狗可以延长宠物寿命。
sents.p: hé lǐ de wéi gǒu kě yǐ yán cháng chǒng wù shòu mìng
sents.en: If you feed your dog properly, you can increase his lifespan.

sents.zh: 他的缺席导致了各种谣言的产生。
sents.p: tā de quē xí dǎo zhì le gè zhǒng yáo yán de chǎn shēng
sents.en: His absence gave birth to all sorts of rumors.

sents.zh: 我听到了一个很有意思的谣言。
sents.p: wǒ tīng dào le yī gè hěn yǒu yì si de yáo yán
sents.en: I heard a very interesting rumor.

sents.en: Water steams when it boils.

sents.zh: 你鬼点子真多。
sents.p: nǐ guǐ diǎn zi zhēn duō
sents.en: You're very resourceful.

sents.zh: 我们睡过头了。
sents.p: wǒ men shuì guò tóu le
sents.en: We overslept.

sents.zh: 汤姆睡过头了。
sents.p: tāng mǔ shuì guò tóu le
sents.en: Tom overslept.

sents.zh: 上个月我参加了三场葬礼。
sents.p: shàng gè yuè wǒ cān jiā le sān cháng zàng lǐ
sents.en: I went to three funerals last month.

sents.zh: 很多人都参加了他的葬礼。
sents.p: hěn duō rén dōu cān jiā le tā de zàng lǐ
sents.en: Many attended his funeral.

sents.zh: 窗帘是房间变漂亮了。
sents.p: chuāng lián shì fáng jiān biàn piào liang le
sents.en: The curtains make this room beautiful.

sents.zh: 他从窗帘后出来了。
sents.p: tā cóng chuāng lián hòu chū lái le
sents.en: He came out from behind the curtain.

sents.zh: 所有美国人都需要缴税。
sents.p: suǒ yǒu měi guó rén dōu xū yào jiǎo shuì
sents.en: All Americans have to pay their taxes.

sents.zh: 他狼吞虎咽地吃了一顿。
sents.p: tā láng tūn hǔ yān de chī le yī dùn
sents.en: He devoured his meal.

sents.zh: 老人咽下了最后一口气。
sents.p: lǎo rén yān xià le zuì hòu yī kǒu qì
sents.en: The old man breathed his last.

sents.zh: 汤姆今天来得比往常要早一些。
sents.p: tāng mǔ jīn tiān lái de bǐ wǎng cháng yào zǎo yī xiē
sents.en: Tom came a little earlier today than he usually does.

sents.zh: 我和往常一样起得很早。
sents.p: wǒ hé wǎng cháng yī yàng qǐ de hěn zǎo
sents.en: I got up early as usual.

sents.zh: 她过去的生活仅够糊口。
sents.p: tā guò qù de shēng huó jǐn gòu hú kǒu
sents.en: She used to live hand to mouth.

sents.zh: 我对祖母的记忆很模糊。
sents.p: wǒ duì zǔ mǔ de jì yì hěn mó hu
sents.en: I have a dim memory of my grandmother.

sents.zh: 你知道分辨好坏吗？
sents.p: nǐ zhī dào fēn biàn hǎo huài ma
sents.en: Do you know the difference between good and bad?

sents.zh: 我常常能分辨出来一个人是不是瞒着我什么事情。
sents.p: wǒ cháng cháng néng fēn biàn chū lái yī gè rén shì bù shì mán zhe wǒ shén me shì qing
sents.en: I can usually tell when someone is hiding something from me.

sents.zh: 不管发生什么，我还是会遵守诺言。
sents.p: bù guǎn fā shēng shén me wǒ hái shi huì zūn shǒu nuò yán
sents.en: I'll keep my word, whatever may happen.

sents.zh: 他这个人话不多，但总是遵守诺言。
sents.p: tā zhè gè rén huà bù duō dàn zǒng shì zūn shǒu nuò yán
sents.en: He is a man of few words, but he always keeps his promise.

sents.zh: 我可以借用您的眼线笔吗？
sents.p: wǒ kě yǐ jiè yòng nín de yǎn xiàn bǐ ma
sents.en: Could I borrow your eyeliner?

sents.zh: 我能借用你的剪刀吗？
sents.p: wǒ néng jiè yòng nǐ de jiǎn dāo ma
sents.en: Can I borrow your scissors?

sents.zh: 我认为，要找到汤姆可不容易。
sents.p: wǒ rèn wéi yào zhǎo dào tāng mǔ kě bù róng yì
sents.en: I don't think it's going to be easy to find Tom.

sents.zh: 他们好不容易才回答了他们老师的问题。
sents.p: tā men hǎo bù róng yì cái huí dá le tā men lǎo shī de wèn tí
sents.en: They answered their teacher's question with difficulty.

sents.zh: 昨天强盗闯进了店里。
sents.p: zuó tiān qiáng dào chuǎng jìn le diàn lǐ
sents.en: A burglar broke into the shop yesterday.

sents.zh: 我们得到了在这个海湾内捕鱼的特权。
sents.p: wǒ men dé dào le zài zhè gè hǎi wān nèi bǔ yú de tè quán
sents.en: We were granted the privilege of fishing in this bay.

sents.p: wǒ hái shi gè xīn shǒu

sents.en: His speech was short and to the point.

sents.p: wǒ wèi nǐ chōng dāng dǎo yóu
sents.en: I'll act as a guide for you.

sents.zh: 汤姆竭尽全力追赶。
sents.p: tāng mǔ jié jìn quán lì zhuī gǎn
sents.en: Tom did his best to catch up.

sents.zh: 她的演说感动了听众。
sents.p: tā de yǎn shuō gǎn dòng le tīng zhòng
sents.en: Her speech moved the audience.

sents.zh: 他是个很有野心的人。
sents.p: tā shì gè hěn yǒu yě xīn de rén
sents.en: He was a man of great ambition.

sents.zh: 他对古董很有鉴赏力。
sents.p: tā duì gǔ dǒng hěn yǒu jiàn shǎng lì
sents.en: He has an eye for antiques.

sents.zh: 她看古董的眼光很好。
sents.p: tā kàn gǔ dǒng de yǎn guāng hěn hǎo
sents.en: She has an eye for antiques.

sents.zh: 我觉得你是时候该懂事了。
sents.p: wǒ jué de nǐ shì shí hou gāi dǒng shì le
sents.en: I think it's time for you to grow up.

sents.zh: 你们这些家伙真不懂事。
sents.p: nǐ men zhè xiē jiā huo zhēn bù dǒng shì
sents.en: You guys are totally clueless.
